items.title: On Monday in Oil and Gas, Federal Hormuz Data Lands as Two Acquisitions Are Announced
items.summary: Oil Market Daily News Commentary - Oil prices fell on Monday, Reuters reported, citing signs that oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz are recovering, which it said reinforced expectations of ...
items.body:
News
/ PR Newswire
/ On Monday in Oil and Gas, Federal Hormuz Data Lands as Two Acquisitions Are Announced

On Monday in Oil and Gas, Federal Hormuz Data Lands as Two Acquisitions Are Announced 7 min read

XOM TRP TRP CNQ
HOUSTON, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oil Market Daily News Commentary  - Oil prices fell on Monday, Reuters reported, citing signs that oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz are recovering, which it said reinforced expectations of surplus supply. The same day, the U.S. Energy Information Administration published new quarterly figures on oil moving through the strait, a tanker transiting it outbound reported being struck, and two North American producers announced acquisitions. The December NYMEX West Texas Intermediate contract settled at $88.56 a barrel on Friday, Nov. 13, according to CME Group, which had not posted official settlements for Monday when this article was prepared. Active Companies from around the markets with current developments this week include: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation ( XOM ) , TC Energy Corporation ( TRP ) ( TRP ) , Canadian Natural Resources Limited ( CNQ ) ( CNQ ) , Diamondback Energy, Inc. ( FANG ) , and Weatherford International Corp ( WFRD ) .
New federal numbers on the strait
The EIA's Global Energy Security Data, released Monday, put total oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz at 9.1 million barrels per day in the third quarter of 2026. That compares with 5.1 million barrels per day in the second quarter of 2026 and 21.4 million barrels per day in the third quarter of 2025. Of the third-quarter 2026 total, crude oil and condensate accounted for 7.3 million barrels per day and petroleum products for 1.8 million barrels per day.
The agency noted that since the end of February 2026, AIS signal data for ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz have become especially unreliable, and that 2026 Hormuz tanker tracking data are being revised frequently.
Shipping reports from the region
UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said in incident report #207, dated Nov. 16, that in an incident in the Strait of Hormuz, the Company Security Officer of a tanker reported the vessel being struck by an unknown projectile whilst transiting outbound. UKMTO said this resulted in a fire in the engine room, that no casualties have been reported and all crew have been accounted for, and that damage assessment and environmental impact were unknown at the time of the report.
Separately, Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Monday that two oil tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Reuters, which said it could not independently verify the report.
Reuters also reported that the International Energy Agency said on Friday the world oil market will return to a surplus in the fourth quarter of this year, with oil supply averaging 105 million barrels per day in the quarter, 1.7 million barrels per day higher than forecast demand.
Supply from Guyana and pipe in Alberta
A news release posted Monday by ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation ( XOM ) said ExxonMobil Guyana announced startup of production at Uaru, the fifth development in Guyana's offshore Stabroek block, raising Guyana's installed production capacity to 1.1 million barrels per day. The release said the Errea Wittu vessel is expected to achieve its initial production capacity of 250,000 barrels per day in the first quarter of 2027.
"The startup of Errea Wittu is another major milestone for Guyana and ExxonMobil," said ExxonMobil Upstream Company President Dan Ammann. "In just over a decade, Guyana has become one of the world's fastest-growing and most important new sources of energy supply."
TC Energy Corporation ( TRP ) ( TRP ) on Monday shared its next phase of growth on its NGTL System, including plans for the proposed Alberta Growth Connector, an approximately 370-kilometre, 48-inch, west-to-east natural gas pipeline that would connect Western Canadian natural gas supply to Alberta's oil sands region via NGTL. The company said its 2026 NGTL System Annual Plan, which is subject to finalization, forecasts total demand on the system will increase approximately 25 per cent, from 14.4 billion cubic feet per day in 2026 to approximately 18 billion cubic feet per day in 2031. The proposed connector and related facilities remain subject to securing commercial support, engagement with rightsholders and stakeholders, regulatory approvals and TC Energy's project-sanctioning process.
"Growing natural gas demand across Alberta reinforces NGTL's role as a foundational part of TC Energy's business and a core platform for future growth," said François Poirier, TC Energy's President and Chief Executive Officer.
Oil Market Daily's sister site, Stock Preachers, offers a free 27-page guide, Knowledge is Power , with 10 chapters in plain English on the two skills every trade comes down to: reading the news and reading the chart. Readers who sign up also receive The Roadmap every Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
Two acquisitions in two basins
Canadian Natural Resources Limited ( CNQ ) ( CNQ ) announced Monday that it has entered into a definitive arrangement agreement with Advantage Energy Ltd. relating to the acquisition of all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Advantage for cash. The company said the acquisition includes production of approximately 79,000 BOE/d of Montney and Charlie Lake assets. The transaction is targeted to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the satisfaction of conditions typical for a transaction of this nature.
Canadian Natural's President, Scott Stauth, stated, "Advantage Energy is an excellent strategic fit for Canadian Natural. The acquisition builds on our significant Montney and Charlie Lake positions and provides additional synergies of scale to further improve on area efficiencies."
Diamondback Energy, Inc. ( FANG ) said Monday it has entered into a definitive purchase agreement to acquire certain subsidiaries of Double Eagle IV Midco, LLC and Double Eagle V Midco, LLC in exchange for approximately 15.56 million shares of Diamondback common stock and $2.15 billion of cash, subject to customary adjustments. The company listed approximately 176,000 net acres in the core of the Midland Basin and estimated 2027 oil production of approximately 35 MBo/d (92 MBoe/d, 38% oil). Diamondback said it expects the transaction to close on December 21, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.
"This acquisition is another important step in Diamondback's continued growth within the Midland Basin," stated Kaes Van't Hof, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Diamondback.
Offshore services
Weatherford International Corp ( WFRD ), which announced on Nov. 13 that it had completed its redomestication from Ireland to Delaware, said Monday it has been awarded a contract by Constellation to provide deepwater managed pressure drilling (MPD) solutions for an exploration campaign. The award comprises an initial 12-month rental period for Weatherford's deepwater MPD technology and equipment, the sale of an MPD system to be delivered within 12 months and a two-year aftermarket contract, and builds on Weatherford's May 2026 managed pressure drilling award with Constellation in Brazil. The release did not disclose a contract value.
Girish Saligram, Weatherford's President and Chief Executive Officer, commented, "Brazil is a key growth market for Weatherford, and this award with Constellation strengthens our position as the leading MPD provider in the country while opening a multi-year pathway of equipment, systems and aftermarket services as the exploratory campaign held by the Amaralina Star (UDW Drillship) advances."
The calendar from here
Seven OPEC+ countries, including Saudi Arabia and Russia, decided at a Nov. 1 meeting to maintain September 2026 required production for December 2026, according to an OPEC press release, and said their next meeting will be held on Nov. 29, 2026. The EIA's next Short-Term Energy Outlook is scheduled for release on Dec. 8, 2026.

Nov 16 (Reuters) – Russian President Vladimir Putin could meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un if he also comes to China for this week’s APEC summit, Interfax news agency quoted Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov as saying on Monday.

“Of course, if he is at the APEC summit,” Interfax quoted Peskov as saying.

Peskov made his comments as Putin met a delegation in the Kremlin from North Korea’s ruling Workers’ Party.

Show Full Article

Putin asked the delegation, headed by senior party official Jo Yong Won, to pass on best wishes to Kim Jong Un.

“I place great value on the fact that we have developed business and friendly relations, which undoubtedly help us resolve and develop ties between our countries,” Putin said.

Russia and North Korea have developed closer links in recent years, including the signature of a 2024 treaty on a strategic partnership, which includes a mutual defence provision.

North Korea has sent about 14,000 to 15,000 troops to support Russia’s war in Ukraine since 2024, according to Ukrainian and South Korean estimates, with most deployed in the Kursk region to help repel a Ukrainian incursion.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy cited intelligence as saying on Monday that North Korea was sending new supplies of dozens of North Korean ballistic missiles every month, enabling Pyongyang to make its weapons more effective.

(Reporting by Reuters; Editing by Daniel Wallis)

items.title: EE.UU. propone endurecer los requisitos para que empresas patrocinen green cards a extranjeros
items.author: Alicia Caldwell
items.summary: Las empresas tecnológicas llevan mucho tiempo utilizando este programa para ayudar a los empleados con visados de trabajo temporales a obtener la tarjeta verde, lo que les permite permanecer en EE.UU.
items.body: Bloomberg — El Departamento de Trabajo de Estados Unidos propuso normas más estrictas para las empresas que buscan patrocinar a trabajadores extranjeros para obtener la residencia permanente, al señalar que quiere reforzar las protecciones para los estadounidenses afectados por despidos. La propuesta modificaría el programa de Certificación Laboral Permanente, un paso del proceso para muchas green cards basadas en el empleo que, por lo general, exige a los valores demostrar que no hay trabajadores estadounidenses calificados disponibles para un puesto, según un aviso publicado el lunes. Ver más: IBM recortará el patrocinio de visas H-1B para la mayoría de los puestos de su división de consultoría El departamento señaló que los cambios reforzarían la protección de los trabajadores estadounidenses afectados por despidos, incluidos aquellos contratados a través de empresas de trabajo temporal, y obligarían a los empleadores a informar de los recortes de plantilla. Las empresas también tendrían que esforzarse más por contratar a trabajadores estadounidenses cualificados antes de solicitar la autorización para patrocinar a un empleado extranjero. Las empresas tecnológicas llevan mucho tiempo utilizando este programa para ayudar a los empleados con visados de trabajo temporales a obtener la tarjeta verde, lo que les permite permanecer en EE.UU. de forma permanente. La propuesta dificultaría dicho proceso, ya que el Gobierno presiona al sector para que contrate a más estadounidenses. El aviso indica que el documento se publicará en el Registro Federal el martes, y que el público dispondrá de 60 días para presentar comentarios por escrito. El mes pasado, el vicepresidente JD Vance anunció que a ocho empresas tecnológicas y de externalización, entre ellas Microsoft ( MSFT ) y Adobe, se les había prohibido indefinidamente patrocinar a empleados para la obtención de tarjetas de residencia en el marco del programa PERM, mientras las autoridades investigaban si habían abusado del sistema. En un comunicado, Microsoft defendió su uso de los programas de visados y afirmó que esperaba poder facilitar a la Administración información adicional. Ver más: Países que no le piden visa a los venezolanos en 2026-2027 La propuesta se suma a los esfuerzos de la Administración por restringir la inmigración patrocinada por las empresas, incluidas las medidas para aumentar las tasas de los visados H-1B para trabajadores cualificados y de los permisos de trabajo para titulados internacionales en el marco del programa de Formación Práctica Opcional. NEW YORK: A broad selloff dragged US stocks lower on Monday (Nov 16) as fallout from Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO soured enthusiasm for AI stocks , raising the stakes for the chipmaker's earnings report on Tuesday and Anthropic's initial public offering later in the week.
The risk-off sentiment gathered momentum as the session progressed, with the S&P 500 dropping nearly 2 per cent and the Dow falling more than 1.4 per cent. The Nasdaq suffered the steepest percentage loss, tumbling 2.5 per cent, as the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor Index weighed on the tech-heavy index. The SOX lost 5.3 per cent.
"It's the back-and-forth in this market of the AI-related stocks catching a bid versus this rotation trade," said Ross Mayfield, investment strategy analyst at Baird in Louisville, Kentucky. "Over the last couple of weeks, it's like a day-to-day thing where, you know, some days the AI names absolutely rip and then the very next day, you know, they're in a freefall."
"There are signs underneath the surface that investors aren't panic-selling and running away from the asset class altogether, but are probing other corners of the equity market," Mayfield added.

Nvidia slid 4.1 per cent, extending its losses after Huang's resignation following allegations of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, adding to concerns over the emerging technology's rapid expansion and potential risks.
Huang's departure prompted the Trump administration to issue a new rule restricting China's access to the best AI chips from companies like Nvidia ahead of US President Donald Trump's expected meeting with his Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping.

Related:

Trump says 'would not mind' Huang being reinstated at Nvidia

US to curb China's access to AI chips as Trump heads to Asia

It marks an abrupt reversal of fortune for the sector. In mid-June the SOX index was up 106.6 per cent year-to-date. But that luster has faded in recent months, reducing its 2026 gain to around 43 per cent, still about four times the gains of the broader S&P 500 so far this year.
That retreat helped pull the Nasdaq more than 10 per cent below its all-time closing high reached on October 6, confirming the index is in a correction.
Analysts expect Nvidia to post a 90.4 per cent year-on-year earnings jump on revenue of US$109.10 billion.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 739.38 points, or 1.41 per cent, to 51,608.17, the S&P 500 .SPX lost 145.08 points, or 1.92 per cent, to 7,416.59 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 626.51 points, or 2.49 per cent, to 24,509.76.
WARSH REMARKS, RATE-HIKE PROBABILITY US Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said on Monday that technologies will have a significant impact on the economy, but the possible scenarios range from rising growth with broadly shared gains to higher unemployment and a potential slowdown if anticipated investment returns prove disappointing.
Minutes from the Federal Open Market Committee's latest meeting, due for release on Wednesday, could offer clues on the policy outlook ahead of next month's interest-rate decision.

items.title: トランプ・メディア、転換社債で10億ドル返済迫られる恐れ　株価過去最低圏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[１６日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）を運営するメディア企業、トランプ・メディア・アンド・テクノロジー・グループは今月、転換社債の保有者から１０億ドルの現金返済を請求される可能性に直面している。株価が過去最低水準近辺で推移し、資産の半分以上を暗号資産（仮想通貨）が占める中、同社は大きな圧力にさらされている。

同社の提出書類によると、２０２５年５月に発行されたこの１０億ドルの転換社債は、２８年に満期を迎えるが、保有者は１１月３０日に現金での返済を請求することができる。社債は１株当たり３４．７２ドルで株式に転換されるが、これは現在の株価を大きく上回っている。 

９月３０日時点で、同社の総資産は２４億７０００万ドルを超え、このうちおよそ５５％にあたる約１３億６０００万ドルが暗号資産だった。トランプ・メディアが保有するトークンは、ビットコインと、クリプト・ドット・コムの独自トークンであるクロノスの２種類のみである。 

暗号資産への集中は、暗号資産価格が低迷を続けた場合、現金による返済を困難にする恐れがある。暗号資産情報サイトのコインゲッコーのデータによると、ビットコインは直近で６万４５０５．２０ドルと、１０月の高値から約５０％下落。クロノスは今年に入って５２．４％値下がりした。

トランプ・メディアの株価は一時、９．５％安の４．２０ドルと、今月初めに付けた過去最低値の３．８０ドルに近い水準を付けた。同社の株価は年初来で３分の２超の価値を失っている。 

トランプ・メディアはロイターのコメント要請に直ちには応じなかった。

items.title: 米国株式市場＝大幅安、ＡＩ懸念で　エヌビディア決算に注目
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Stephen Culp

［ニューヨーク　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Stephen Culp

［ニューヨーク　１６日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は幅広い銘柄が売られ、大幅安で取引を終えた。ジェンスン・フアン氏のエヌビディア最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）辞任の余波で人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株への投資意欲が冷え込み、１７日の同社決算発表と週内に予定されるアンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）への注目が一段と高まった。

取引が進むにつれてリスク回避の動きが強まり、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種は２％近く、ダウ工業株３０種は１．４％超下落した。下落率はナスダック総合が最大で、２．５％安となった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）の下落が、ハイテク株の多いナスダック総合を押し下げた。ＳＯＸ指数は５．３％下落した。

ベアードの投資戦略アナリスト、ロス・メイフィールド氏（ケンタッキー州ルイビル）は「市場では、ＡＩ関連株に買いが入る動きと、他の銘柄に資金が移る動きが交互に起きている。ここ数週間は日替わりのような状況だ。ＡＩ関連株が急騰したかと思えば、翌日には急落している」と指摘。

その上で、「表面的な値動きの裏では、投資家がパニック売りに走って株式全体から撤退しているのではなく、株式市場の他の分野を探っている兆候がある」と語った。

エヌビディアは４．１％安と、下げが続いた。中国のスパイと疑われる人物との不倫疑惑を受けてフアン氏が辞任したことで、ＡＩの急速な拡大と潜在的なリスクへの懸念が強まった。

フアン氏の辞任を受け、トランプ政権は、エヌビディアなどの最先端ＡＩ半導体への中国のアクセスを制限する新たな規則を打ち出した。トランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席の会談が予定される中での措置となる。

半導体セクターの状況は急変した。ＳＯＸ指数の年初来上昇率は６月中旬に１０６．６％に達していたが、ここ数カ月で勢いが衰え、約４３％に縮小した。それでも、幅広い銘柄で構成するＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種の年初来上昇率の約４倍に相当する。

半導体株の下落が響き、ナスダック総合は１０月６日に付けた終値ベースの過去最高値から１０％超下落し、調整局面入りが確認された。

アナリストは、エヌビディアの利益が前年同期比９０．４％増加すると予想している。売上高は１０９１億ドルを見込んでいる。

個別銘柄では、半導体メーカーのインテルとマイクロン・テクノロジーがともに７％超下落した。

ＡＩ向けクラウドサービスを手がけるコアウィーブは６．１％安、競合のネビウスは７．６％安となった。

大規模クラウド事業者のアルファベット、アマゾン・ドット・コム、メタ・プラットフォームズは２．４─４．１％下落した。

サーバーメーカーのデル・テクノロジーズは７．０％安、スーパー・マイクロ・コンピューターは６．９％安だった。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では、値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．４５対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも３．２７対１で値下がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１７９億１０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１８６億６０００万株。

パティンソンは、２０２１年公開の「００７／ノー・タイム・トゥ・ダイ」を最後に同役を退いた英俳優ダニエル・クレイグの後任として、７代目ボンドを演じることになる。

items.body:
Marie-Louise Gumuchian

[ロンドン １６日 ロイター] - 米アマゾンＭＧＭスタジオは１６日、人気スパイ映画「００７」シリーズの新たなジェームズ・ボンド役に英国人俳優ロバート・パティンソン（４０）を起用すると発表した。

パティンソンは、２０２１年公開の「００７／ノー・タイム・トゥ・ダイ」を最後に同役を退いた英俳優ダニエル・クレイグの後任として、７代目ボンドを演じることになる。

パティンソンは声明で、「ジェームズ・ボンドは映画史上最も伝説的なキャラクターの一人であり、００７を任されることは生涯に一度の栄誉だ」と述べた。

パティンソンは２００５年の「ハリー・ポッターと炎のゴブレット」で映画デビュー。その後、「トワイライト・サーガ」 などに出演し、２２年公開の「ザ・バットマン」で主演を務めた。

英国王室はパティンソン起用を歓迎し、公式インスタグラムで「秘密情報部へようこそ、ボンド氏」とコメントした。

ボンド役を巡っては、ジャック・ローデンやカラム・ターナーらも候補として名前が挙がっていた。 

１９６２年に第１作が公開された００７シリーズは、ハリウッド史上最も息の長い映画シリーズの一つ。世界興行収入は７０億ドル超に上る。初代ボンド役は故ショーン・コネリーが務め、クレイグは１５年にわたり同役を演じた。

シリーズ最新作はアマゾンＭＧＭスタジオが初めて手がける００７作品となる。監督はＳＦ映画「ＤＵＮＥ／デューン 砂の惑星」などで知られるカナダ出身のドゥニ・ヴィルヌーヴが務める。

items.title: US Moves to Curb China’s Chip Access
items.summary: The Trump administration issued an interim rule requiring data center operators in several countries to obtain a US government license before exporting advanced AI chips from American manufacturers to customers in those countries. Bloomberg Senior Editor for Technology & Strategic Industries Michael Shepard explains the move. Then, Bloomberg’s Mike McKee interviews Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack on why she believes tighter rate policy moves are needed. Then, Bloomberg Law Immigration Reporter Andrew Kreighbaum explains the new Trump Administration proposal to righted rules for employer-sponsored green cards. Finally, Bank of America Head of Family Office Elizabeth Thiessen discusses the bank’s latest Family Office Study. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 米航空便ほぼ正常化も再び混乱、ユナイテッドで一時システム障害
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
David Shepardson

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 米国の空の便は１６日、ほぼ正常運航を回復した。米連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）による１３日の航空機の離陸停止措置を受けた混乱により、３日間で１万８０００便以上が欠航、約２万８０００便が遅延した。ただ運航再開が進む中、ユナイテッド航空でシステム障害が発生し一時的に混乱が生じた。

ユナイテッドの障害は出発便に約１時間影響し、米東部時間１６日午後６時（日本時間１７日午前８時）までに復旧した。他の航空会社への影響はなかった。

フライト追跡サイト「フライトアウェア」によると、米東部時間１６日午後６時５０分時点で、ユナイテッドは運航予定の２０％に当たる６４５便が遅延し、２５便が欠航した。 

航空各社は１３日のＦＡＡによる全米規模の離陸停止措置からの復旧を進めていたため、このうち何便が１６日のシステム障害の影響を受けたかは不明だった。

離陸停止は、定期保守中に設置された１台のルーターが原因だった疑いがある。

ＣＮＢＣのインタビューに応じたダフィー運輸長官は、この混乱による経済的影響は数十億ドルに上ると推定した。

フライトアウェアによると、米東部時間１６日午後６時時点で、全米の欠航は３４４便、遅延は４８００便となり、１５日の欠航２３００便以上、遅延１万１０００便から大幅に減少した。

証券会社バーンスタインは、全米規模の離陸停止により、米航空大手４社の利益が計３億４５００万ドル押し下げられる可能性があると推計している。

items.title: イラン当局、イスファハン州の防空システム作動報道を否定　濃縮施設所在
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１６日 ロイター] - イラン中部イスファハン州の治安当局者は１６日、同州で防空システムが作動したとの報道を否定した。イスファハン州にはウラン濃縮施設がある。ＳＮＮ通信が伝えた。

イランの複数メディアはこの日、イスファハン州で防空システムが作動したと報じたが、理由については伝えていなかった。

ＳＮＮ通信によると、イスファハン州のサレヒ副知事（治安担当）は「イスファハン州の上空で敵の航空機は確認されておらず、防空部隊と軍は通常の活動を続けている」と述べた。

Investors cooled on data center stocks in third quarter, filings show

FAST

Nov 16 : Institutional investor enthusiasm for data-center stocks waned in the third quarter, with more funds completely exiting positions than opening new ones, while buying of artificial intelligence and semiconductor stocks remained positive but concentrated, regulatory filings showed.
At least 138 funds completely sold their data-center positions during the period, compared with 119 that initiated new positions, according to a Reuters analysis of nearly 6,400 Securities and Exchange Commission 13F filings from pensions, hedge funds, wealth managers and others.
The number of institutional investors that were holders of a group of eight publicly traded companies identified by Reuters as among the largest data center stocks declined to 3,392 from 3,411 in the previous quarter.
Heavy investment in AI infrastructure and computing capacity led by technology companies ranging from Nvidia to Microsoft earlier this year had lifted a slew of stocks related to data centers, including Vertiv Holdings and Digital Realty Trust as well as utilities and power stocks that stood to gain from such facilities' surging electricity needs. But enthusiasm for that trade has been dampened by growing concerns over whether the US midterm election results would lead to political curbs on data center construction.

The retreat was sharpest in utilities and power stocks, with 212 funds exiting such positions, more than double the 96 that initiated new ones, the filings show.
FUNDS ADJUST AI HOLDINGS
By contrast, institutional investors remained net buyers of semiconductor and AI stocks, although new positions only slightly outpaced complete exits.
In semiconductors, 2,951 funds, or 51 per cent of those holding the stocks across both quarters, increased their positions, while 2,584, or 44.7 per cent, reduced them. Just 77 funds initiated new positions, against 69 that exited completely. AI stock holdings tracked a very similar pattern, with the total number of institutional holders of such shares rising by just 33.
Shares of AI companies took a hit globally in the third quarter after top industry executives warned of existential risks from the technology, shaking confidence in a sector whose massive infrastructure spending has driven world stock markets to record highs.
Institutional investors are required to disclose their equity holdings in the quarterly 13F filings with the SEC. These offer a snapshot of positions at quarter-end but do not disclose the reasons behind investment decisions.
The third quarter of 2026 ended on September 30, over a month before the Nasdaq selloff after the US midterm elections.

Source: Reuters

US to curb China's access to AI chips as Trump heads to Asia

The restrictions aim to stop China from accessing advanced US chips through other countries.

FAST

WASHINGTON: The Trump administration said on Monday (Nov 16) it will further restrict China's access to the best AI chips from companies like Nvidia, as US President Donald Trump began a trip to China to meet with President Xi Jinping.
The new restrictions on chip exports to overseas data centres would hurt Chinese companies that use data centres in countries like Thailand and Malaysia to access advanced chips to train their artificial intelligence models .
The rule h ighlights how the Commerce Department is scrambling to show it is cracking down on Chinese access to sensitive American technology. It follows reporting that the agency turned a blind eye to smuggling of advanced Nvidia AI chips into China and f ai led to curb Chinese access to overseas data centres that allowed us ers to circumvent the restrictions .
Trump is set to meet with Xi in China's southern city of Shenzhen on Thursday , the site of this week's APEC summit. Trump often unleashes punitive tech threats or action ag ai nst Beijing ahead of such meetings.

The rule also requires companies in Singapore, Th ai land, Malaysia, Indonesia and Brazil to apply for US export licenses for advanced chips , citing the five countries as presenting a higher-than-normal risk of illegally diverting the chips to China.

Related:

Singapore assessing impact of new US chip export controls aimed at curbing China’s access

LUTNICK WITH TRUMP ON CHINA VISIT Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is among administration officials joining Trump on the trip to Asia , a White Ho us e official s ai d. Lutnick has faced intense criticism for his role in overseeing export controls on chips to China in the wake of the Nvidia scandal.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned on Thursday after admitting to an aff ai r with an executive at Singapore-based cloud company and Nvidia partner Megaspeed, which rents computing power at its data centers and has come under scrutiny for possible illegal diversion of chips to China.
Senior White Ho us e officials have disc us sed whether Lutnick should be p us hed out, Reuters reported last week.
Trump , speaking to reporters as he departed the White Ho us e for the trip to the Philippines and China, said he has no plans to replace Lutnick. Asked if he still had confidence in him, he said, "Yeah, I do."
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent s ai d on Friday that four government agencies had favored putting Megaspeed on a trade blacklist but the Commerce Department, which was in charge, had not . His comments placed the blame on Lutnick.
"It's a different viewpoint. One wants to be friendly with China and one wants to have a blowup with China," Trump said on Monday. "They both are acceptable but they are different views."
Trump also said he would not mind seeing Huang return as Nvidia CEO, adding his voice to calls for Huang's reinstatement.
Megaspeed s ai d in a Nov 15 statement that it complies with all applicable laws and regulatory regimes, including US export control requirements.

Related:

Commentary: Jensen Huang’s downfall will accelerate US-China ‘great decoupling’

Trump says he might meet with North Korea's Kim Jong Un in China

T IGHTER EXPORT CONTROLS Kate Koren, a former Commerce official, s ai d the rule a nnounced on Monday would have a much bigger impact on China than adding a single entity to the Commerce Department's trade blacklist, known as the "Entity List."
"Nvidia and Jensen himself were key drivers of the argument for selling chips to China as a strategy," Koren s ai d. "The revelations last week put that argument into question, and the pendulum is swinging in the other direction - towards tighter export controls."
The Commerce Department s ai d in a statement that the new rule was written by the Department of the Treasury and the National Security Council, which also directed its release.
"The rule is designed to ensure that existing restrictions on access to sensitive American technology cannot be circumvented through remote computing arrangements involving data centres in third countries," the statement s ai d.
The rule requires overseas data centres that provide a significant volume of compute power to companies headquartered in China to obt ai n US export licenses within 90 days to continue the services or face future export restrictions.
The license requirement will not apply to systems us ed by online ret ai lers and social media companies, which the department s ai d do not pose the same national security threat.
The new regulation also formally rescinds a Biden-era rule that limited global access to AI chips through licensing requirements.
The Commerce Department s ai d in early 2025 that it would not enforce the rule, and would rescind and replace it. But it did not take action until Monday, allowing billions of dollars' worth of restricted Nvidia chips to flow to data centres us ed by Chinese AI companies.

Source: AFP/fs

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル指数1年7カ月ぶり高値、円は介入警戒水準
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　１６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　１６日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、主要通貨に対するドル指数が２０２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。先週発表された強いインフレ指標に加え、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者によるタカ派的な発言を背景にドルが買われやすい地合いが続いている。ドルは対円ではやや下落したものの、ドル／円相場は日米当局が介入を実施したとみられる水準近辺で推移しており、当局による介入リスクが意識されている。

終盤の取引で、主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．１％高の１０３．５０と、２０２５年４月２日以来の高水準を付けた。ユーロは対ドルで０．１％安の１．１００７ドル。

ドルは対円で０．２％安の１５９．３８円。内閣府が発表した７─９月期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値が年率換算で０．１％減となったことが日銀の金融政策にどのような影響を及ぼすか見極める動きが広がった。ステート・ストリート・インベストメント・マネジメント（東京）のチーフ債券ストラテジスト、マサヒコ・ルー氏は「賃金やサービス価格、基調的な国内需要に弱さが広がらない限り、日銀は今回の景気の弱含みを一時的なものとみなす可能性が高い」としている。

米労働省が先週１０日に発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比０．４％上昇。食品や住居費の上昇を背景に市場予想（０．３％）を上回り、ＦＲＢは１２月８─９日に開く連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で追加利上げに動くとの観測が高まった。

ウォラーＦＲＢ理事が先週、米国の１０月のインフレ率が鈍化したとしてもＦＲＢは１２月の会合で利上げを支持する考えを示し、物価情勢が悪化した場合は０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げを検討する必要があると述べたこともあり、１２月の会合で０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げが実施される確率が一時上昇。ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、１２月の会合で０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は約９５％となっている。

マクロ調査会社マクロ・ハイブのリサーチャー、ベンジャミン・フォード氏は「インフレが依然として安心できない水準にあり、来年にＦＲＢがタカ派的なサプライズをもたらす余地もあることを踏まえると、ユーロ／ドルは年末までに１．０８ドルに達する可能性は十分ある」と述べた。

この日のＦＲＢ当局者の発言としては、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が新興技術は経済に大きな影響を及ぼすとしながらも、想定されるシナリオは恩恵が幅広く共有される中での成長加速から、失業率の上昇、投資収益が期待を下回った場合の景気減速まで多岐にわたるとの見方を示した。

クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は、米国のインフレ圧力は強まっているとの認識を示しながらも、ＦＲＢが一段と積極的な利上げ路線に移行する段階には至っていないと述べた。

今週は米半導体大手エヌビディアが１７日に発表する第３・四半期（８―１０月期）決算のほか、１９日に予定されるＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）が注目されている。

米労働省が先週１０日に発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比０．４％上昇。食品や住居費の上昇を背景に市場予想（０．３％）を上回り、ＦＲＢは１２月８─９日に開く連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で追加利上げに動くとの観測が高まった。

ウォラーＦＲＢ理事が先週、米国の１０月のインフレ率が鈍化したとしてもＦＲＢは１２月の会合で利上げを支持する考えを示し、物価情勢が悪化した場合は０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げを検討する必要があると述べたこともあり、１２月の会合で０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げが実施される確率が一時上昇。ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、１２月の会合で０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定される確率は約９５％となっている。

マクロ調査会社マクロ・ハイブのリサーチャー、ベンジャミン・フォード氏は「インフレが依然として安心できない水準にあり、来年にＦＲＢがタカ派的なサプライズをもたらす余地もあることを踏まえると、ユーロ／ドルは年末までに１．０８ドルに達する可能性は十分ある」と述べた。

この日のＦＲＢ当局者の発言としては、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が新興技術は経済に大きな影響を及ぼすとしながらも、想定されるシナリオは恩恵が幅広く共有される中での成長加速から、失業率の上昇、投資収益が期待を下回った場合の景気減速まで多岐にわたるとの見方を示した。

クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は、米国のインフレ圧力は強まっているとの認識を示しながらも、ＦＲＢが一段と積極的な利上げ路線に移行する段階には至っていないと述べた。

今週は米半導体大手エヌビディアが１７日に発表する第３・四半期（８―１０月期）決算のほか、１９日に予定されるＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）が注目されている。

Nov 16 (Reuters) – The European Union on Monday added four Haitian criminal gangs to its global human rights sanctions list for serious violations against children including killings, sexual violence and recruiting children as soldiers.

• The gangs sanctioned include 5 Segond, Gran Ravine, 400 Mawozo and Krazé Baryè, all accused of violence against children, sexual violence, killings and attacks on health infrastructure

• The EU is using the sanctions to prevent grave violations against children in armed conflict, namely: killing and maiming of children; recruitment or use of children as soldiers; sexual violence against children; abduction of children; attacks against schools or hospitals; and denial of humanitarian access for children

Show Full Article

• The sanctioned entities face asset freezes and travel bans, and EU citizens and companies will not be allowed to make funds available to them

• In February this year, the United Nations reported there had been an “alarming increase” in the number of children being recruited into gangs in Haiti with “devastating consequences” for children, families and society as a whole

• Violence across the country resulted in over 1,160 deaths between July and September 2026, including multiple child fatalities, the United Nations Integrated Office in Haiti reported last week

(Reporting by Harold Isaac, Writing by Iñigo Alexander, Editing by Edward Tobin)

Tesla plans $3.3 billion Cybercab boost for Germany's troubled auto sector

FRANKFURT, Nov 16 : Tesla will invest €3 billion ($3.3 billion) in its German gigafactory, it said on Monday, bucking the downsizing trend among its German rivals as Elon Musk's EV maker presses ahead with ambitious expansion plans for its Cybercab model.
The planned construction of an additional production facility in Gruenheide on the outskirts of Berlin could make the US company's only European site Germany's largest auto plant by capacity, overtaking Volkswagen's Wolfsburg headquarters.
Tesla has emerged as one of the few growth stories in German auto manufacturing. Local heavyweights Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz and BMW are all cutting jobs and considering plant closures in the face of growing Chinese competition.
Germany has not been overwhelmingly welcoming, however. Tesla has faced environmental protests against the Gruenheide plant and repeated clashes with the country's powerful manufacturing union. Questions also remain over prospects for the Cybercab model intended to underpin this latest expansion.

PRODUCTION SLATED TO BEGIN IN 2029
Tesla aims to produce up to 1 million Cybercab robotaxis annually in Gruenheide, the company said in an emailed statement to Reuters, though the model has yet to be sold anywhere at scale commercially.
The company said it would submit a building permit application for the Gruenheide project before the end of the year. Construction is scheduled to begin in the first half of 2027, with production set to start in 2029.
Tesla said it would create more jobs at Gruenheide, with several hundred new workers sought for the first step of construction and production planning.
While acknowledging the project as much-needed positive news for the German car industry, automotive sector analyst Matthias Schmidt said questions remain.
"Germany should ask how much of that investment will result in sustainable, long-term employment, and how much will be automated, low-labour work moving forward?" he said.
CYBERTRUCK MAKES WAY FOR CYBERCAB
Opened in March 2022, Tesla's Gruenheide factory was built in a fraction of the time typically required for major industrial projects in Germany, overcoming environmental challenges and permitting hurdles.
However, local management has repeatedly clashed with Germany's powerful IG Metall union, which has accused the company of union-busting tactics. Tesla says IG Metall is serving its own interests.
In recent months, Tesla has ramped up production of its Model Y mid-sized SUV at the site and hired more than 2,000 new employees. It is also aiming to launch battery cell production at the factory from the middle of next year.
Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at its Austin factory in Texas at the end of summer 2027, which Musk said should make way for more Cybercabs.
($1 = 0.9073 euros)

items.title: Microsoft revela por qué una falla oculta desde julio paralizó Outlook, Teams y Copilot la semana pasada
items.author: Matt Day
items.summary: La interrupción del servicio supuso una situación complicada para Microsoft y sirvió de recordatorio de los riesgos que conlleva depender en tal medida de un único proveedor de tecnología.
items.body: Bloomberg — El error que afectó el funcionamiento del software de productividad de Microsoft ( MSFT ) la semana pasada llevaba oculto y sin ser detectado en los centros de datos de la compañía desde julio. Cuando el fabricante del software realizó una redistribución rutinaria del tráfico de usuarios el 11 de noviembre, el sistema falló. Posteriormente, los servidores esenciales para Outlook, Teams, el asistente de IA Copilot y otros servicios comenzaron a fallar, lo que finalmente provocó interrupciones del servicio para usuarios de todo el mundo. Ver más: Microsoft restablece todos sus servicios tras una caída que afectó a empresas en todo el mundo Durante las siguientes 15 horas, en medio de fallas intermitentes en sus servidores, la compañía apenas sospechaba que se estaba gestando un problema mayor, según un informe preliminar que Microsoft envió a sus clientes el domingo por la noche. Luego, la empresa pasó otras 15 horas identificando el problema y comenzando a implementar una solución, un tiempo que parece una eternidad en un mundo conectado que depende en gran medida del software de Microsoft. Las acciones de Microsoft bajaban alrededor de un 1% a las 14:29 horas del lunes. Microsoft. Símbolo: MSFT:UN. Clase de activo: equity. Poco después de las 20:00 h, hora de Nueva York, del 11 de noviembre, el tráfico procedente del servicio de videoconferencia y chat Teams se redirigió automáticamente a un sistema independiente de servidores que también gestiona el tráfico de Outlook. Esto, junto con una pérdida de capacidad de los servidores provocada por un problema no relacionado a principios de semana, desencadenó el fallo, lo que provocó que los servidores agotaran su memoria tras un incremento inesperado del tráfico. Los servidores comenzaron a fallar. El problema se agravó debido a que los sistemas automatizados redirigieron los correos electrónicos y el tráfico de los usuarios hacia lo que el sistema de Microsoft consideraba otros servidores en buen estado, lo que provocó que el fallo se manifestara también allí. A las 11:30 de la mañana del 12 de noviembre —justo cuando el tráfico procedente de las empresas de EE.UU. alcanzaba su punto álgido—, Microsoft se dio cuenta de que tenía un problema. Ver más: Él es Gaurav Sareen, la persona encargada en Microsoft de que Outlook funcione bien La empresa tardó otras 15 horas en resolver el problema y empezar a implementar una solución. Mientras tanto, el trabajo en muchas de las empresas y organismos públicos clientes de Microsoft se paralizó, ya que las bandejas de entrada de correo electrónico no se cargaban, las invitaciones de Teams desaparecían y los trabajadores recurrían a las llamadas telefónicas y al papel y lápiz. La interrupción del servicio supuso una situación complicada para Microsoft y sirvió de recordatorio de los riesgos que conlleva depender en tal medida de un único proveedor de tecnología. Charles Lamanna, vicepresidente ejecutivo de Microsoft encargado de supervisar el software para el entorno laboral de la empresa, se disculpó el lunes por la mañana por la interrupción en una publicación en la red social X, en la que ofrecía más detalles sobre lo que había fallado. Una cronología más exhaustiva, incluida en una actualización dirigida a los profesionales de la tecnología que utilizan el paquete de software Microsoft 365, reveló cómo los esfuerzos automatizados de la empresa por mantener su software en funcionamiento contribuyeron a desencadenar un fallo en cadena. En el momento más crítico del jueves, más del 80% de los servidores que dan servicio a Outlook no respondían. Este tipo de interrupciones suelen durar, como mucho, unas pocas horas. En este caso, se prolongó más tiempo porque, tan pronto como los servidores volvían a estar operativos, se veían desbordados por el tráfico acumulado y volvían a fallar. Además, dado que el error había pasado desapercibido durante meses, los esfuerzos por estabilizar el sistema revirtiendo las actualizaciones recientes no surtieron efecto. Microsoft prueba los cambios en su red en laboratorios y en pequeñas partes de la misma antes de implementarlos a gran escala, un protocolo estándar para las empresas que prestan grandes servicios en línea. Ver más: Microsoft obliga a operadores bursátiles a recurrir al fax y WhatsApp por fallo global Según Lamanna, este fallo no se detectó porque los patrones de tráfico simulados y el hardware de los laboratorios de la compañía no reflejaban las condiciones reales a las que se enfrentaron los servidores posteriormente. Las pruebas de Microsoft suelen centrarse en sistemas más antiguos y menos potentes para evaluar si las actualizaciones podrían afectar al punto débil de la nube de la compañía. El fallo que provocó el bloqueo de los servidores es más destructivo en hardware más moderno con mayor capacidad de procesamiento. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

In recent months, Tesla has ramped up production of its Model Y mid-sized SUV at the site and hired more than 2,000 new employees. It is also aiming to launch battery cell production at the factory from the middle of next year.
Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at its Austin factory in Texas at the end of summer 2027, which Musk said should make way for more Cybercabs.

New York Mayor Mamdani disbands ‘notorious’ police unit that used excessive force on protesters

By Jonathan Allen
NEW YORK, Nov 16 (Reuters) – New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani is disbanding a police unit criticized for using excessive force against protesters in favor of a new “civilian-led approach” to large public demonstrations, he announced on Monday.

Mamdani promised in his election campaign last year to disband the police department’s Strategic Response Group, a decade-old anti-terrorism unit that has faced legal challenges for its rough tactics at street protests, including the use of pepper spray by armed officers in riot gear and mass arrests.

In the joint announcement alongside New York City Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch, Mamdani said he is creating a new civilian-led group called the Community Dialogue and De-escalation Division, whose members would be unarmed and would not have arrest powers.

Show Full Article

At the New York Police Department, he said the disbanded SRG unit would be replaced in part by a new unit called the Patrol Support Division, which he said would police protests differently.

“New Yorkers exercising their constitutional right to protest should not be met with the same police response as a terrorism threat,” the mayor said in a statement.

A ‘NOTORIOUS’ UNIT

The SRG was rebuked in a 2023 legal settlement after New York Attorney General Letitia James, the New York Civil Liberties Union and others sued over excessive force against protesters, journalists and legal observers during protests against police violence in the summer of 2020.

The NYCLU and other civil rights groups cautiously welcomed Mamdani’s announcement, while expressing concern that the new Patrol Support Division might end up a rebranding of the SRG, not a disbanding.

The Legal Aid Society, the city’s largest public defender’s office, on Monday commended the disbanding of “one of the NYPD’s most notorious units” in a statement, but said the new unit “will require vigilant oversight to ensure that the SRG’s tactics are not repeated.”

The NYCLU said it will be “monitoring this new unit closely, including for compliance with our 2023 settlement with the City.”

Tisch, who runs one of the world’s largest police forces and its nearly $7 billion annual operating budget, said there were about 500 SRG officers who would be reassigned within the department before next spring. Some, she added, would go to the existing Counterterrorism Bureau.

“Nothing would change about the way that the NYPD responds to crowd control conditions,” Tisch told ABC’s Eyewitness News in a joint interview with the mayor.

A spokesperson for the mayor did not respond to queries about how the new Patrol Support Division would differ from the SRG, or whether it would be staffed by former SRG officers.

Police unions criticized the move, saying it would endanger the safety of officers and the public.

“The next time your life is disrupted by demonstrators who are blocking bridges and roadways or causing chaos on our streets, remember: Mayor Mamdani is on their side, not yours,” Patrick Hendry, president of the Police Benevolent Association, said in a statement.

(Reporting by Jonathan Allen in New York; Editing by Jesse Mesner-Hage and Aurora Ellis)

items.title: クリーブランド連銀総裁、小幅な利上げ選好　インフレ圧力強まるも＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１６日、米国のインフレ圧力は強まっているとの認識を示...
items.body:
クリーブランド連銀総裁、小幅な利上げ選好　インフレ圧力強まるも＝報道
4:50 配信

８月２７日撮影　REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） [１６日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１６日、米国のインフレ圧力は強まっているとの認識を示しながらも、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が一段と積極的な利上げ路線に移行する段階には至っていないとの見解を改めて示した。

ハマック総裁はブルームバーグＴＶのインタビューで「私はより小幅な利上げを好む」と述べ、「政策運営の予見可能性が高いほど、企業や家計は資金運用計画を立てやすくなる」とし、「ＦＲＢが後手に回り、一段と強い金融引き締めが必要になった場合、大幅な利上げに踏み切ることは十分可能だ」と語った。

ウォラーＦＲＢ理事は１０日、米国の１０月のインフレ率が鈍化したとしても１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げを支持する考えを示し、物価情勢が悪化した場合は０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げを検討する必要があると述べていた。

ハマック総裁は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持つ。インフレの２％目標への回帰に向け、一貫して利上げを支持しており、今年に入り政策金利の据え置きが決定された会合では２回にわたり反対票を投じた。

労働市場については、安定しているがさほどダイナミックではないと指摘。その上で、雇用需給の逼迫を示す兆候が見られるとして、こうした動向を注視する必要があるとの認識を示した。

その上で「ＦＲＢの責務の両面が、追加的な金融引き締めの必要性を示唆している可能性があり、われわれが最終的に到達する点に関する見方を変更することになり得る」と述べた。

また、金融環境は依然として景気抑制的な水準には達しておらず、こうした状況は経済全般で見られるとの認識を示した。

items.title: ＪＰモルガンで取引処理遅延、ソフトのバグ原因　送金などに影響か
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１６日　ロイター］ - 米銀最大手ＪＰモルガン・チェースは１６日、ソフトウエアのバグ（不具合）で取引の処理に問題が生...
items.body:
ＪＰモルガンで取引処理遅延、ソフトのバグ原因　送金などに影響か
4:37 配信

2025年12月1日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration（ロイター） ［１６日　ロイター］ - 米銀最大手ＪＰモルガン・チェースは１６日、ソフトウエアのバグ（不具合）で取引の処理に問題が生じたと明らかにした。処理が遅れた取引を受け取る側の銀行にも影響が及んだ可能性があるという。

同行の広報担当者は「自社で運用するハードウエアシステムで、ソフトウエアのバグに関連した一時的な問題が発生した。サイバー攻撃に関連しているという証拠はない。一部の顧客への対応に通常より時間がかかっている」と述べた。

広報担当者によると、顧客は引き続き口座や資金にアクセスできる。同行は問題の解決に全力を挙げている。広報担当者は「システム全体に波及する問題ではない。他行が取引の遅れによる影響を受けた可能性があるのは、当行との取引の当事者だった場合に限られる」と説明した。

障害情報サイト「ダウンディテクター」によると、１６日にはバンク・オブ・アメリカ（ＢｏｆＡ）、ＵＳバンク、ウェルズ・ファーゴの利用者から問題が報告されていた。

ＢｏｆＡとウェルズ・ファーゴはコメントを控えた。

ＵＳバンクの広報担当者は、同行のシステムに直接の影響は出ていないと説明した。その上で「ただ、他の金融機関との間で個人間送金サービスによる送金や受け取りを行おうとしている顧客には、取引の遅れが生じる可能性がある」と述べた。

先週、 米マイクロソフトの「チームズ」や「アウトルック」などの業務ソフト「マイクロソフト３６５」で世界規模の障害が発生し、１３日には、航空管制センターでの通信障害によって、全米の空港で約４時間にわたり離陸が停止した。１０月には暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者のバイナンスが大規模なハッキング被害に遭っており、一般利用者の間でシステム障害に対する不安が強まっている。

items.title: Tiff Macklem to step down as Bank of Canada governor at end of his term
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The Bank of Canada says Tiff Macklem will not seek a second term as governor and plans to step down when his current run expires on June 2, 2027.
items.body: OTTAWA — Bank of Canada governor Tiff Macklem will step down at the end of his term, which began in the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic and saw him navigating the central bank through the subsequent period of higher inflation.   “It has been the highlight of my career to serve as the 10th governor of the Bank of Canada,” Macklem said in a news release Monday. He said his tenure came as Canada navigates a world that is more fragmented and shock-prone. “The bank has faced these challenges by acting decisively, by using sound judgment in the face of uncertainty, and by serving Canadians with humility and a steadfast commitment to its mandate,” he said.  Macklem was named governor in May 2020 and took over the top job in June of that year, overseeing the bulk of Canada’s monetary policy response to the COVID-19 pandemic.  At the time of the appointment, he was the dean of the business school at the University of Toronto. Macklem was also a former second-in-command at the Bank of Canada, serving as senior deputy governor between 2010 and 2014 when Prime Minister Mark Carney headed the Bank of Canada. In March 2020, a few months before Macklem took over, the Bank of Canada cut interest rates to the emergency level of 0.25 per cent in an effort to help the economy weather the shock.  Two years later, the central bank began a historic interest rate hiking campaign to bring inflation down to its two per cent target level. Canadians should be thankful for Macklem’s service, Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne said Monday while speaking to reporters on Monday.  “He’s been doing a good service to Canadians and serving for a long time ... there’s a normal course of things that you would launch a selection process to replace him in due course,” he said. “But today is the moment to say thank you governor for your service to the nation, your service to Canadians and the Canadian economy.” The central bank’s board of directors says it has started a search process to select the next governor, with the recruitment process expected to be completed by the spring.  The next governor is slated to serve a seven-year term beginning June 3, 2027.  The board’s choice will be subject to approval by the minister of finance and the federal cabinet. Potential successors to Macklem include Bank of Canada senior deputy governor Carolyn Rogers. She serves as the bank’s second-in-command, however, the person holding that position has been passed over for the top job in recent decades. Carolyn Wilkins, who served as senior deputy governor from May 2014 to December 2020, is also a potential candidate after playing a key role in the central bank’s response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Likely private sector candidates include Jean Boivin, the head of BlackRock Investment Institute, and Scotiabank chief economist Jean-François Perrault. Both Boivin and Perrault have previously held positions at the central bank and in government. --- This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 16, 2026.

FAST

LONDON, Nov 16 : Flagship Pioneering is opening its first lab for creating companies outside the United States, putting £100 million ($131.94 million)  behind a new UK-based effort to fund and build AI-driven biotech companies, the venture firm said on Monday. 
The move is a first for a firm that has created more than 130 companies, including Moderna, and operated only from the United States for more than 25 years.  
Flagship's move comes after three years of groundwork in Britain. The company opened its London office in 2023 near the Francis Crick Institute in King’s Cross and its local team has since built partnerships with academia, government and regulatory groups. 
"We concluded that this might well be the right next step in our evolution," Noubar Afeyan, founder and CEO of the venture firm, told Reuters in an interview. The Flagship Origination lab will be anchored at the firm's London office.

Afeyan said that the firm will not buy into existing companies, and instead plans to "cast a wide net" for partnerships with universities, corporations and funders. 
It hopes its £100 million will attract £500 million or more from partners. Flagship expects to recruit about 50 scientist-entrepreneurs and operators in Britain initially. 
AI will run through every stage of the lab’s work, from invention to clinical trials, said Afeyan, who is also the chairman of Moderna. 
Afeyan said the country's main draw is the National Health Service and the patient data it has gathered, which lets researchers begin with real-world evidence to find disease targets before developing drugs.   
Flagship companies are already testing that approach, including drug developer Generate Biomedicines , which completed an early-stage trial of an AI-designed drug for asthma in Manchester. 
Afeyan cautioned that the use of AI in the field is still early.
"We're in an age where I think AI's most fundamental contribution in the first instance will be to shed a light on actually what's happening mechanistically in diseases," he said. 
($1 = 0.7579 pound)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] - 米連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）による１３日の全米に及ぶ航空機の離陸停止措置を受けた混乱により、米航空...
items.body:
米航空大手4社の減益3億ドル超、全米の離陸停止措置受け＝バーンスタイン
3:57 配信

米連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）が全米の運航停止措置を解除した後、欠航・遅延便を表示する発着案内板。バージニア州アーリントンのロナルド・レーガン・ワシントン・ナショナル空港で１１月１４日撮影。REUTERS/Eric Lee（ロイター） [１６日 ロイター] - 米連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）による１３日の全米に及ぶ航空機の離陸停止措置を受けた混乱により、米航空大手４社の税引き前損益が合計で３億４５００万ドル下押しされるとの推計を、証券会社バーンスタインが明らかにした。

航空データサイト「フライトアウェア」によると、ＦＡＡの停止措置を受けて、米東部時間１６日午前８時４７分までの時点で、米発着の１万８５００便超が欠航。バーンスタインはアメリカン航空、デルタ航空、ユナイテッド航空、サウスウエスト航空への影響額を試算した。バンク・オブ・アメリカのリポートによると、１５日の欠航率はアメリカン航空で２２％、ジェットブルー航空は２８％と高い一方、ユナイテッド、サウスウエスト、デルタは３─５％にとどまった。

当局者は１４日、混乱の原因が防衛・通信機器大手Ｌ３ハリス・テクノロジーズが設置したルーターによる可能性があると指摘した。

ダフィー米運輸長官は１５日にＡＢＣテレビの番組で、１６日までに運航は完全に正常化するとの見通しを示した。ダフィー氏は１６日にＣＮＢＣで、今回の混乱が数十億ドルの損失につながる可能性があるとした上で、議会に対し、航空管制システムの更新に向けた予算を迅速に承認するよう求めた。

items.title: Higher gas, grocery prices keep inflation elevated at 3.1% despite relief elsewhere
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Canada’s inflation rate held steady in October as higher prices for gas, groceries and clothes were partly offset by cheaper cellphone plans and slower rent price growth, Statistics Canada said Monday ...
items.body: OTTAWA -- Canada’s inflation rate held steady in October as higher prices for gas, groceries and clothes were partly offset by cheaper cellphone plans and slower rent price growth, Statistics Canada said Monday. The annual rate of inflation was steady at 3.1 per cent last month, slightly below economists’ expectations of 3.2 per cent. The inflation reading raises questions about whether the Bank of Canada will need to raise interest rates again in December, said Benjamin Reitzes, BMO’s managing director of Canadian rates and macro strategist. “There’s nothing in these numbers at the moment that really screams rate hike for the Bank of Canada,” he said. “They’ve been particularly hawkish over the past few weeks and they raised rates in October and signalled that more could be necessary.” Reitzes said October’s inflation numbers “don’t necessarily signal that they need to do something immediately, but again, that doesn’t mean they won’t. There’s no clearcut case here either way.” Gasoline continued to be a key driver of headline inflation, rising 30.9 per cent year-over-year in October compared with 27.8 per cent the month before amid continued conflict in the Middle East and Ukraine. Higher energy costs could eventually push up prices elsewhere, said Royal Bank of Canada economist Abbey Xu. “The longer energy prices remain elevated, the more cost pressures will filter through to consumer prices with a lag,” she said in a client note.  “The path of energy prices also remains highly uncertain despite the decline in gasoline prices so far in November.” StatCan said gasoline prices rose at a faster annual pace last month partly because prices fell sharply in October 2025, making the year-over-year increase appear larger. On a monthly basis, however, gasoline prices fell 2.5 per cent in October. Excluding energy, annual inflation eased to two per cent in October from 2.1 per cent in September. “Underlying price pressures stayed comparatively contained,” Xu said, noting that the consumer price index excluding both food and energy slowed to 1.8 per cent.  RBC’s diffusion index, which measures how widespread inflation is across the economy, continued to show that “unusually strong price growth has been concentrated in a relatively narrow share of the consumer basket,” she said.  Meanwhile, Canadians once again faced higher prices at grocery stores. StatCan said the cost of food purchased from stores accelerated to two per cent year-over-year in October after four consecutive months of slower price growth. Fresh vegetable prices rose 1.4 per cent year-over-year in October after falling 2.9 per cent in September while condiments, spices and vinegars were up 2.6 per cent. Compared with October 2020, the agency said grocery prices have climbed 31.9 per cent. Even as inflation slows, Canadians are still feeling the effects of years of rising prices, Reitzes said. “The reality is inflation is only prices going higher; prices don’t come back down in general,” he said. “What we need to happen is a lengthy period of relatively low inflation and some good wage growth and that’ll make everyday Canadians feel much better.” Meanwhile, prices for clothing were up 1.8 per cent in October, driven by a 2.2 per cent year-over-year increase in women’s clothing and a 1.4 per cent increase in men’s clothing. Clothing prices were up 3.4 per cent month-over-month in October, the largest monthly increase since September 2019. StatCan said the price increases coincided with higher shipping costs. In Ontario, prices for natural gas rose three per cent year-over-year in October after declining 18.7 per cent in September. Prices for cellphone plans fell 6.2 per cent year-over-year in October, after rising 0.8 per cent in September. StatCan said the decline was largely due to comparisons with a year ago, when companies had raised prices. Slower rent price growth also helped ease inflation, particularly in British Columbia, while rents in Ontario rose 1.1 per cent year-over-year in October. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 16, 2026. By Brett Bundale

Nov 16 : California Attorney General Rob Bonta sued OpenAI on Monday, accusing the company of developing a dangerous product without adequate safety procedures or oversight after reports that its AI models had independently carried out cyberattacks.
The lawsuit is the first filed by a state over the cyberattacks, which have drawn widespread attention since the revelation in July that an autonomous agents powered by OpenAI’s advanced artificial intelligence models went rogue during a security test and hacked AI startup Hugging Face. Filed in state court in San Francisco, the lawsuit accuses the company of violating California consumer protection law and creating a public nuisance by risking public safety.
A representative for OpenAI did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The lawsuit seeks a court order directing the company to stop violating the law, ensure its testing and development of its models are done safely and pay for its violations, Bonta, a Democrat, said at a press conference announcing the lawsuit.

“The Hugging Face attack was the predictable result of an internal culture at OpenAI that prioritizes growth and rapid model development over safety and accountability — and this was only one of 80 known incidents,” Bonta said in a statement.
The lawsuit accuses the company of misleading consumers about its efforts to test its models safely, in violation of the state's consumer protection laws, and of impeding Californians' use of property by disrupting local organizations and services. 
After the Hugging Face incident, OpenAI said in a blog post that the breakout was "an unprecedented cyber incident, involving state-of-the-art cyber capabilities."
OpenAI acknowledged a general need for more transparency around rogue AI behavior and said it was reinforcing its safeguards. On September 16, the company published a new framework for disclosing such incidents, saying it would err on the side of transparency “even when significance is uncertain.”
MOUNTING PRESSURE FOR AI REGULATION
OpenAI and other AI firms have disclosed a series of other AI agent breakouts, often weeks or months after they occurred, and in some cases only after independent researchers discovered them. The Trump administration and US legislators face mounting pressure to address the risk, particularly to the energy and banking sectors and emergency services.
US legislators are debating AI regulation, with some proposing a bill that would require developers of the most powerful AI models to submit them for independent security audits. 
Multiple attorneys general have said they are investigating breaches tied to OpenAI's models.
OpenAI is already facing several other states' lawsuits over the safety of its models for users. Last month, a bipartisan group of eight states sued OpenAI in courts across the country alleging ChatGPT coached users, including teenagers, to harm themselves or others.
The company is also the subject of lawsuits filed by people who say they were harmed as a result of the chatbot’s actions, including more than 30 filed over a mass shooting that took place in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, in February. An OpenAI spokesperson called the shooting a tragedy and said the company has strengthened ChatGPT safeguards.

items.title: Bangladesh’s $40 billion garment industry faces fresh protests over wages: Could supply chain disruptions benefit India?
items.author: Bhanu Pratap
items.summary: Bangladesh’s $40 billion garment industry faces fresh wage protests, with over 60 factories shut as workers demand a monthly minimum wage of 30,000 taka. The disruption could prompt global retailers to diversify sourcing and benefit India.
items.body:
Bangladesh’s garment industry is facing renewed labour unrest, with fresh wage protests forcing factories to shut across major manufacturing hubs.
The disruption threatens production and export schedules in the country’s $40 billion apparel sector, raising questions about whether international retailers could shift more orders to alternative manufacturing destinations, including India.
Police fired tear gas and sound grenades on Monday, November 16, to disperse protesting garment workers in Gazipur, around 25 km north of Dhaka.
More than 60 factories remained shut across Savar, Ashulia and Gazipur amid the unrest, The Daily Star reported. In Gazipur alone, 17 factories were ordered to close indefinitely, according to Prothom Alo.
At the centre of the protests is a demand to raise the monthly minimum wage to 30,000 taka from the existing 12,500 taka.
Workers say their current earnings are insufficient to cope with rising living costs, particularly expenses on food, transport and healthcare.
The latest agitation has intensified after a scheduled meeting of the government's Minimum Wage Board was postponed on November 16.
The board was expected to review pay in the garment sector and recommend a revised wage structure. The delay triggered fresh anger among workers, The Daily Star reported.
Why Bangladesh’s garment industry is under pressure
Bangladesh’s ready-made garment (RMG) industry, valued at around $40 billion, is a crucial pillar of its economy. It employs more than four million workers, contributes roughly 10% to the country's GDP and accounts for over 80% of its export earnings, according to Reuters and the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
The country is the world's second-largest apparel exporter after China and has built its global position on large-scale production and relatively low labour costs. Its factories supply leading international fashion retailers, making Bangladesh an important sourcing destination for global brands.
However, workers have increasingly argued that wages have failed to keep pace with inflation and the rising cost of living. Their demand for a monthly minimum wage of 30,000 taka represents a substantial increase over the existing 12,500 taka.
The wage dispute has already disrupted factory operations on a significant scale. Reuters reported on November 1 that protests had forced 529 factories to shut, leaving nearly 987,200 workers without work.
Road blockades and clashes with police have added to the uncertainty, while factory owners have warned that prolonged stoppages could affect production, shipment schedules and payments from international buyers.
Could India benefit as global brands diversify sourcing?
The continuing disruption could strengthen India's appeal as an alternative manufacturing destination for international apparel buyers looking to reduce their dependence on Bangladesh.
There are already signs of a broader sourcing reassessment.
The Financial Express reported in October that major international retailers, including H&M, Inditex — the parent company of Zara — and Primark, were shifting some orders away from Bangladesh as they reassessed supply-chain risks.
Industry participants cited rising production costs, energy-related challenges and uncertainty over Bangladesh's future trade advantages among the factors influencing sourcing decisions.
The latest wage protests could add to those concerns. For global retailers operating on tight production and delivery schedules, prolonged factory closures can disrupt inventory planning and delay shipments.
If the unrest continues, buyers may look to spread orders across other manufacturing hubs, including India, to reduce their exposure to disruptions in Bangladesh.
India already has an established textile and apparel manufacturing base, with major production centres in Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Karnataka and Maharashtra. Its ready-made garment exports stood at around $15.99 billion in FY25, according to the Ministry of Textiles.
The government's provisional figures put India's textile and apparel exports, including handicrafts, at ₹3.25 lakh crore in FY26.
India's manufacturing ecosystem, domestic raw-material base and established textile clusters could help it attract some of the orders that international buyers may seek to diversify.
The opportunity is not necessarily limited to replacing production lost during factory shutdowns in Bangladesh. Indian manufacturers could also benefit from a longer-term shift towards multi-country sourcing as global retailers seek to reduce supply-chain concentration risks.
Why India may struggle to absorb Bangladesh’s orders immediately
Despite the opportunity, India may not be able to absorb a large volume of orders from Bangladesh at short notice.
The neighbouring country has developed a vast garment-manufacturing ecosystem specialising in high-volume, cost-competitive production, particularly for global fast-fashion retailers.
Replicating that scale and capacity would be difficult in the short term. Indian manufacturers face their own challenges, including fluctuating raw-material costs, logistics expenses, fragmented production and the need to meet large orders within tight delivery schedules.
The Economic Survey 2025-26 has highlighted structural weaknesses in India's textile sector, including fragmentation and small-scale operations across parts of the value chain. It has also pointed to the industry's heavy reliance on cotton and gaps in man-made fibre manufacturing.
These constraints could limit India's ability to take on large volumes of additional orders immediately, even if international buyers begin looking for alternatives.

米ハイテク企業が集積するシリコンバレーの有力者の間では、フアン氏復帰を求める声が高まっているほか、トランプ大統領は１６日、フアン氏のエヌビディアＣＥＯへの復帰に異存はないとの認識を示した。

items.author: ロイター

Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir

[サンフランシスコ １６日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（...
items.body:
ＡＩの影響、成長加速から混乱まで多岐　幅広い可能性に備え＝ＦＲＢ議長
2:40 配信

2026年10月28日撮影。REUTERS/Kylie Cooper/File Photo（ロイター） Howard Schneider　Ann Saphir

[サンフランシスコ １６日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォーシュ議長は１６日、新興技術は経済に大きな影響を及ぼすと述べた。ただ、想定されるシナリオは、恩恵が幅広く共有される中での成長加速から、失業率の上昇、投資収益が期待を下回った場合の景気減速まで多岐にわたるとした。

ウォーシュ氏は人工知能（ＡＩ）について、トランプ米大統領が好んで使う「超知能」という言葉で言及。「アイデアの創出を飛躍的に加速」する力として、従来の技術とは一線を画す可能性があると述べた。

サンフランシスコで開かれるＦＲＢのＡＩ会議向けに用意した講演原稿で、最良のシナリオでは、この技術が「生産性の向上につながり、経済的な恩恵が労働者と資本の所有者に幅広く行き渡る可能性がある。その場合、実質国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率は長期平均を持続的に上回り、米国は完全雇用に近い状態を維持する」と述べた。

一方、失業率の上昇や「悪意ある者」によるＡＩの利用などのリスクもあり、「深刻な混乱と大きな経済的損失」をもたらす可能性もあると指摘した。

ＦＲＢが経済や中央銀行業務への影響を探るためＡＩの専門家を集めたことについて、「われわれの仕事は、今後どのような展開になっても対応できるよう備えることだ」と述べた。「この問題でわれわれが担う役割は、推進でも反対でもない。われわれの責務は、この技術の普及が経済に大きな影響を及ぼし、将来の金融政策に重要な意味を持つことを認識することだ」と説明。「大きな問いは、その影響の大きさ、範囲、時期だ」と述べた。

その上で、「人間を過小評価すべきではない。新技術をどう使うかを決めるのは人間でなければならない」とした。

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 16 : Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said on Monday that emerging technologies will have a significant impact on the economy, but the possible scenarios range from rising growth with broadly shared gains to higher unemployment and a potential slowdown if anticipated investment returns prove disappointing.
Warsh refers to artificial intelligence as "super intelligence," the language preferred by President Donald Trump, and said it could prove distinct from earlier technologies as a force to "supercharge idea generation."
In the best scenario, Warsh told a Fed conference on AI in San Francisco, the technology could lead "to an increase in productivity and economic gains that are shared broadly across labor and the owners of capital. In that event, real GDP growth rises persistently above its long-run average, and the US stays close to full employment."
But Warsh said the risks, including higher unemployment and the use of AI by "bad actors," could also be "highly disruptive and economically costly."

"Our job is to prepare for whatever comes next," he said of the Fed's convening of a group of AI experts to explore the implications of the technology for the economy and central banking.
"Our role in all this is neither advocacy nor opposition. Our responsibility is to recognize that the widespread adoption of this technology will have significant impact on the economy, with important implications for monetary policy down the road," Warsh said. "The big questions are about magnitude, scope, and timing."
The discussion between Warsh and tech industry leaders and academics took place in a San Francisco Fed auditorium before a small invitation-only audience. Those in attendance included Fed Governor Lisa Cook, venture capitalists, money managers, philanthropists, CEOs of technology, healthcare, and other companies, as well as an assortment of economists from across the Fed system, private companies and universities.
While Warsh said the current moment was a "paradigm shift," much of the conversation remained speculative. Panelists discussed how AI might allow the US economy to outpace economies in the rest of the world because of the speed with which new technology and methods are being applied in the US, but also raised concerns that it could undermine learning among students as they become too dependent on the technology.

Source: Reuters

items.body:
カナダ中銀総裁、27年6月に任期満了で退任へ
2:00 配信

2025年9月17日、カナダ銀行のティフ・マックレム総裁　REUTERS/Blair Gable（ロイター） [オタワ １６日 ロイター] -  カナダ銀行（中央銀行）のマックレム総裁は１６日、予定通り２０２７年６月に任期満了で退任すると発表した。新型コロナウイルスのパンデミック（世界的大流行）、米国の関税、イラン紛争への対応に追われた７年間の任期を終える。

マックレム氏は６５歳。退任は広く予想されていた。同中銀では１９８０年代以降、２期目を務める総裁は出ていない。

カナダ中銀は後任総裁を探す委員会を設置し、２７年春までに選考を終える見通しだとした。

スコシアバンクの資本市場経済調査責任者デレク・ホルト氏は、新総裁について「パンデミック時と比べても、総裁がこれまで直面した中で特に複雑な部類に入るリスクの下で、難しいかじ取りを迫られるだろう」と語った。

カナダ中銀は先月、３年余りぶりに政策金利を引き上げた。マックレム氏は、イラン戦争によるエネルギーコストの急騰が幅広い物価上昇につながるのを防ぐため、追加利上げが必要になる可能性があると述べた。

エコノミストによると、経歴などから見ればキャロリン・ロジャース上級副総裁が有力候補となる。ただ、カナダ中銀は０１年以降、過去４回の総裁人事で外部の候補を起用している。女性が総裁に就いた例はない。

エコノミストによると、その他の女性候補としては、２０年に退任するまで同中銀に２０年間在籍したキャロリン・ウィルキンス前上級副総裁や、カナダ・ロイヤル銀行のチーフエコノミスト、フランシス・ドナルド氏が挙がっている。 

また、同中銀では０１年以降、フランス語を母語とする総裁が誕生していないことから、現在ブラックロックのグローバル調査責任者を務めるジャン・ボワバン元副総裁や、ニコラ・バンサン副総裁にも道が開かれる可能性がある。バンサン氏は外部登用の副総裁を約３年間務めた後、２６年に副総裁に就任した。

ただ、誰が後任になっても、政策の大幅な変更を推し進める可能性は低いとみられる。中銀と財務省は、インフレ率を２％前後に維持することを柱とする５年間の金融政策の枠組みを更新したばかりだ。

FAST

Nov 16 : Trump Media & Technology Group faces a possible $1 billion cash demand from convertible debt holders this month, putting pressure on the Truth Social parent as its shares trade near record lows and more than half its assets are digital assets.
The $1 billion in convertible notes, issued in May 2025, mature in 2028, but holders can demand cash repayment on November 30, according to company filings. The notes convert into shares at $34.72, well above the current price.
Trump Media shares were last down 9.5 per cent at $4.20, close to their record low of $3.80 hit earlier this month. The stock has lost more than two-thirds of its value so far this year.
As of September 30, the company had more than $2.47 billion in total assets, roughly 55 per cent of which, or about $1.36 billion, were digital assets. Trump Media holds only two tokens, bitcoin and Crypto.com's native token cronos.

The concentration in digital assets could complicate any cash repayment if crypto prices remain under pressure. Bitcoin was last at $64,505.20, down almost 50 per cent from its October peak, while the cronos token was down 52.4 per cent so far this year, according to CoinGecko data.
The company said in its latest quarterly filing that it would fund any repayment from cash, asset sales, revenue or new equity or debt, and may refinance through a new credit facility.
It said paying holders in stock would not be sensible with shares far below the conversion price, unless the notes require it.
Trump Media did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

items.title: トランプ氏の仮想通貨「＄トランプ」急落、夕食会への関心冷え込み
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michelle Conlin　Tom Bergin

[ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領の公式暗...
items.body:
トランプ氏の仮想通貨「＄トランプ」急落、夕食会への関心冷え込み
1:27 配信

2025年3月7日、米ホワイトハウスで開催された「暗号資産サミット」に出席したトランプ大統領。REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein（ロイター） Michelle Conlin　Tom Bergin

[ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領の公式暗号資産（仮想通貨）「＄トランプ」の購入者を招待する第３回夕食会の当選者が１６日に決定されつつある中、同通貨の取引価格は０．９２ドル前後で推移しており、２０２５年の最高値である７４ドル超から大幅に下落している。

「＄トランプ」は２５年４月、同通貨の購入額上位２２０人をトランプ氏とのプライベート夕食会に招待するとの発表を受け、一時６０％超急騰。富裕な暗号資産投資家らは、トランプ氏が「世界で最も独占的な招待」と宣伝する中、計１億４８００万ドルを投じた。

しかし、１１月２２日に首都郊外にあるトランプ大統領のゴルフクラブで開催予定の第３回夕食会への関心は冷え込んでいる。今回のコンテストでは、「＄トランプ」の保有者１８５人を招待し、９月３０日─１１月１６日のコンテスト集計期間中に最も保有量の多かった人を競うことになっていたが、締め切り時点のリーダーボードには、わずか１３０の暗号資産ウォレットしか表示されず、合計保有額は８６０万ドルと、第１回目の夕食会から９４％減少した。

コンテストのウェブサイトによると、上位２９のウォレットには、ディナーでのＶＩＰ席とともに、「あなたの大好きな大統領」との「特別ＶＩＰレセプション」の特典が贈られる。

オランダ出身の暗号資産起業家モーテン・クリステンセン氏は「世界でも最も影響力のある人物の一人と言える米国大統領と同じ部屋にいられる」とし、「参加するのにほとんど費用がかからないのに、行かない理由があるだろうか」と述べた。同氏にとって、夕食会の参加資格を得るのはこれで３回目だが、大統領とのＶＩＰレセプションに出席するのはこれが初めてだという。同氏は時間加重で約４万１０００ドル相当の「＄トランプ」を保有し、リーダーボードで２６位にランクインした。

トランプ一族のその他の暗号資産関連株や事業も過去最低水準に縮小している。ロイターの推計によると、主要な５つの暗号資産・暗号資産関連プロジェクトの外部投資家は、合計で５０億ドル超を失った。

これら損失の大半は、トランプ氏率いる共和党が民主党に惨敗した中間選挙前に生じたもので、この結果を受けて価格はさらに下落した。

トランプ・ミームコイン・プロジェクトとトランプ・オーガニゼーションは、コメントの要請に応じなかった。ホワイトハウスもコメントの要請に応じなかったが、トランプ大統領の資産は子どもたちが運営する信託に置かれているため利益相反はないと繰り返し主張している。

FAST

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump said on Monday (Nov 16) he might meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un in China this week, an announcement that could dramatically reshape his trip through East Asia .
The president met the North Korean leader several times during his 2017-2021 first term in unprecedented direct diplomacy that failed to persuade Kim to give up his nuclear weapons.
Trump has repeatedly expressed interest in another meeting during his current term, but also previously previewed meetings with Kim that never took place, including during a trip to Asia last year.
Senior US officials have previously said he has no immediate plans for another meeting, while North Korea has said it sees no need for talks at this time and denounced hostile US policies.

Trump told reporters while departing the White House en route to the Philippines and China that any meeting would occur in China, and that the North Korean leader's presence was ultimately up to Chinese President Xi Jinping.
"(Xi) was here ... and we're also going to meet with (Russian) President Putin, and we may meet with Kim Jong Un also," Trump said.
"So that'll be good. We have a chance to accomplish a lot."
Trump added in reference to Kim: "He may come. I don't know. That's up to President Xi."
North Korea's mission to the United Nations did not respond to a request for comment on Trump's remarks.
The Kremlin said on Monday a planned meeting between Putin, Trump and Xi on the sidelines of this week's Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting in China would have a major impact on global affairs.
Trump said he would discuss denuclearisation, Iran and Ukraine with Xi and Putin, as well as trade and the economy, but US officials and analysts have played down the possibility of a meaningful agreement emerging.
Russia's Interfax news agency quoted Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov as saying later on Monday that Putin could meet Kim if he comes to China.

Related:

Snap Insight: US midterms – what an angry ‘lame duck’ president could mean for Asia

North Korea signals little appetite for renewed US dialogue

North Korea has sent about 14,000 to 15,000 troops to support Russia's war in Ukraine since 2024, according to Ukrainian and South Korean estimates, with most deployed in the Kursk region to help repel a Ukrainian incursion.
Victor Cha, head of the Korea program at Washington's Center for Strategic and International Studies think tank, said Trump's comments made clear he had asked Xi to bring Kim to China for a meeting.
"One could see a huge diplomatic victory for Kim if he were to share a stage with the US, Russia, China ... the three other nuclear powers in Asia - in addition to any bilateral with Trump," he said.
"The common narrative is that China would not want to distract from their hosting APEC but I think Xi’s global diplomacy offensive would probably be enhanced, in his mind, if he were bringing together all of the leaders for this extraordinary meeting," Cha said.
Trump's interest in renewed engagement with Kim comes seven years after their last summit ended without agreement when they failed to bridge differences over North Korea's nuclear weapons and sanctions relief.
Since then, North Korea has significantly expanded its nuclear and missile capabilities while strengthening ties with Russia and China, and any willingness by Trump to make major concessions to Pyongyang risks creating friction with regional allies.
Trump has referred to North Korea as a nuclear power, a status allies in the region and the West have refused to recognise despite the dozens of nuclear warheads experts believe Pyongyang has built.

Source: Reuters/fs/ec

FAST

ANTALYA, Turkey, Nov 16 : The 403 hyperscale data centers currently operating around the US emit as much greenhouse gas emissions as the country of Denmark annually, according to a new peer-reviewed study released on Monday.
• The report by Harvard University researchers published in the journal Nature Sustainability found that the country's largest data centers emitted 25.7 million tonnes of carbon dioxide between May 2024 and April 2025.
• That amount was three times higher than in 2018, the last time a peer-reviewed measurement of greenhouse gas emissions from data centers took place.
• The report comes amid heavy backlash against hyperscale data centers in the United States. In the Nov. 3 US midterm elections, data center critics who ran on policies such as moratoria on construction or strengthening regulations were among the biggest winners of the Democrats' landslide victories.

• A lead author of the report said the aim of the report is to bring transparency and data to the debate over data centers and AI. "We are highlighting importance of transparency," said Gianluca Guidi, a Harvard researcher on AI and public health. "We tried and managed to bjuild a methodology that is scientifically accepted to build public trust."
• Hyperscale data centers' electricity consumption and associated CO2 emissions vary widely by region, with Virginia, Oregon, Ohio, and Iowa alone making up over half of the electricity use studied, according to the report. Most of the data centers were powered by gas.

British actor Robert Pattinson named as new James Bond
