FAST

British actor Robert Pattinson will be the next James Bond, Amazon MGM Studios announced on Monday (Nov 16), taking one of cinema's most coveted roles.
The Bond franchise – about a British secret agent known for his charm, his tailored tuxedos and a fondness for martinis "shaken, not stirred" – is among the longest-running and highest-grossing in Hollywood history.
The franchise made its debut in 1962 and the movies have brought in more than US$7 billion in global ticket sales since Sean Connery brought Agent 007 to the big screen in Dr No.
More than two dozen Bond films have been released. The upcoming movie will be the first Bond adventure under Amazon MGM Studios, which took creative control of the film franchise under a new joint venture with longtime rights holders Michael Wilson and Barbara Broccoli in 2025.
Denis Villeneuve, an Oscar nominee known for movies such as the Dune trilogy and Arrival, is set to direct the new film, with a script written by Briton Steven Knight.
Pattinson , who has already had a busy 2026 with films The Odyssey, The Drama and Primetime and who will also feature in Villeneuve's Dune: Part Three, to be released next month, succeeds Daniel Craig, who bowed out of the Bond role after the 2021 movie No Time To Die.
"HONOUR OF A LIFETIME" "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime," Pattinson said in a statement.
"I'm deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya, and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team," Pattinson said, referring to producers Amy Pascal and David Heyman and executive producer Tanya Lapointe.
Pattinson, 40, made his big-screen debut in Harry Potter And The Goblet Of Fire in 2005 and has gone on to star in films such as The Twilight Saga, The Lost City Of Z and Tenet.
He is no stranger to following other actors to play famous characters, having taken on the lead role of the famed caped crusader in 2022 film The Batman.
Pattinson only recently joined a list of reported contenders for the James Bond role that included the likes of Slow Horses actor Jack Lowden and One Night Only star Callum Turner.
Villeneuve said Pattinson has "the timeless soul of 007 and brings a spirit that is completely new".
"I cannot wait to begin," the filmmaker said.
The Bond series is based on novels by Ian Fleming. His first book, Casino Royale, was published in 1953.
Other actors who played Bond include Roger Moore, Timothy Dalton and Pierce Brosnan. George Lazenby played the character in one movie, 1969's On Her Majesty's Secret Service.
The official Instagram account of Britain's royal family welcomed the news, saying, "Welcome to His Majesty's Secret Service, Mr Bond".
Courtenay Valenti, head of film at Amazon MGM Studios, said: "Few films carry the kind of anticipation that comes with James Bond, and we have strived to honour the passionate fans, the legacy, and the future of this iconic character."
"We are thrilled to officially welcome Robert Pattinson as our 007 and are confident he will bring something truly special to this role. Robert, Denis, Amy, David, and Tanya are embarking on an amazing adventure together."

Source: Reuters/dc/fs

Interest in Trump’s meme coin dinner fades as $TRUMP sinks to record lows

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 16 : As winners were being determined on Monday for President Donald Trump's third crypto gala dinner, scheduled for November 22 at his golf club outside Washington, the president's meme coin was trading near 92 cents, a bruising tumble from its high in 2025 of more than $74.
At the peak of Trump's popularity, the token’s price surged more than 60 per cent when the first contest was announced in April 2025. Wealthy crypto investors collectively wagered $148 million on what the president promoted as the “most EXCLUSIVE INVITATION in the world.” The holdings needed to win a seat at the dinner ranged from $59,000 to $18.5 million.
Today, interest in the third meme coin dinner contest has collapsed. It invited 185 holders of the token, known as $TRUMP, to register and see who held the largest amounts during the contest scoring period from September 30 to November 16. The leaderboard at closing showed only 130 crypto wallets — holding a combined $8.6 million — a 94 per cent drop from the first dinner.
The top 29 wallets will be awarded a “Special VIP Reception” with “YOUR FAVORITE PRESIDENT,” according to the contest's website, along with VIP seating at the dinner.

This will be the third time Morten Christensen, a crypto entrepreneur from the Netherlands, has qualified for the dinner, but the first where he will be at the VIP reception with the president. He came in at 26th on the leaderboard with about $41,000 in time-weighted Trump token holdings.
“You can be in a room with the president of the United States, arguably one of the most powerful people in the world,” said Christensen. “So why would I not go if it cost me almost nothing to go?”
His 23-year-old sister, Gabrielle Felen, is also coming along. She bought about 2,000 Trump tokens. She was disappointed she did not make the top 120 — now, she will not get the gift bag. 
TRUMP CRYPTO VENTURES DEFLATE TO LOWS
The contest’s muted results come at a time when the Trump family’s other crypto-connected equities and ventures have also deflated to record lows. Together, outside investors in the five main crypto and crypto-linked projects have lost more than $5 billion, according to Reuters estimates. 
Most of those losses came before the midterm elections in which the Democrats dealt a heavy defeat to Trump’s Republican Party, a result that sent prices even lower. 
Because the price of the Trump token has continued to fall sharply during the holding period in the run-up to the dinner, the winners have lost millions of dollars in recent weeks. 
The Trump meme coin project and the Trump Organization did not respond to a request for comment. The White House also did not respond to a request for comment but has repeatedly said there is no conflict of interest because the president’s assets are in a trust run by his children.
TRUMP FAMILY EARNS BILLIONS
While most buyers have been left with losses, the Trump meme coin has so far earned the Trump family at least $635 million, according to the president’s June financial disclosure statement. In total, a Reuters analysis found that the Trumps have earned at least $2.3 billion through April from their four main crypto ventures, including the meme coin. The president's stake in the fifth crypto-linked venture, Trump Media & Technology Group, is worth about $500 million.
  The billions the Trump family has earned while in office have drawn opposition from congressional Democrats, who retook control of both the US Senate and US House of Representatives in the midterm elections. They will now have subpoena power and the ability to launch investigations and conduct hearings about what US Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Massachusetts Democrat who will lead oversight on the Senate Banking Committee, has characterized as “an orgy of corruption.” Warren said last Monday that the Trump family crypto businesses will be a focus of her accountability investigations. 
Crypto wallets are anonymous and known only by strings of letters and numbers. The anonymity is what prompted government ethics officials to raise concern about the first two dinners because they said the meme coin could be a conduit for anonymous foreign individuals looking to purchase access to the president. Blockchain analysis showed that of the 220 wallets that  competed in the first contest, more than half were likely based outside the United States.

Source: Reuters

items.body:
シリコンバレーでフアン氏復帰を求める声拡大、17万人超署名
11/16 23:45 配信

ジェンセン・フアン氏。9月15日、サンフランシスコで撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria/File Photo（ロイター） [１６日 ロイター] - 米ハイテク企業が集積するシリコンバレーの有力者の間で、半導体大手エヌビディアの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を辞任したジェンセン・フアン氏の復帰を求める声が高まっている。

フアン氏の復帰を求める請願サイト「Stand With Jensen」によると、これまでに１７万７０００人超が署名。著名実業家イーロン・マスク氏のほか、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連アプリ開発企業レプリットのアムジャド・マサドＣＥＯ、エピックゲームズのティム・スウィーニーＣＥＯらが名を連ねている。

さらに、米投資会社アトレイデス・マネジメントのギャビン・ベイカー氏とアルティメーター・キャピタルのブラッド・ガーストナー氏は公開書簡を公表し、事実関係が十分に明らかになる前にフアン氏の後任人事を急がないよう、エヌビディア取締役会に求めた。

フアン氏は複数の不倫関係が発覚したことを受け、１２日に辞任した。このうち１件は中国のスパイと疑われる人物との関係で、同社の先端ＡＩ半導体の対中輸出を巡る疑問が浮上した。これを受けて同社は危機に陥り、フアン氏が資金面で支えてきたＡＩ業界にも衝撃が広がった。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が８月末時点でエヌビディア株を１３００万─６２００万ドル保有していたとみられ...
items.body:
トランプ氏、8月末にエヌビディア株最大6200万ドル保有か＝米紙
11/16 23:26 配信

2025年4月30日、ワシントンD.C.で開催されたイベントで、エヌビディアのフアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ、当時）とトランプ米大統領。REUTERS/Leah Millis/File Photo（ロイター） [１６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が８月末時点でエヌビディア株を１３００万─６２００万ドル保有していたとみられることが分かった。米紙ワシントン・ポストが１６日、同氏の資産開示報告書を精査した結果を報じた。

タイムラグにより報告書には直近２カ月間の取引は反映されていないとした上で、トランプ氏のエヌビディア保有額は、２０２４年末時点で報告された６１万５０００─１３０万ドルを大幅に上回る水準だとしている。

ロイターはワシントン・ポストの報道を直ちに確認できていない。ホワイトハウスとエヌビディアはロイターのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

エヌビディアとトランプ政権との関係には市場の注目が集まっている。エヌビディア共同創業者のジェンスン・フアン氏は先週、中国人女性実業家アリス・フアン氏との関係を巡るスキャンダルを受け、最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を辞任した。アリス・フアン氏は、中国政府との情報活動上のつながりが疑われている。

フアン氏はシリコンバレーにおけるトランプ氏の最も近しい盟友の一人であり、両者の関係は少なくとも２０２５年にさかのぼる。ロイター記者は昨年１２月、トランプ氏の携帯電話にフアン氏の名前が表示されるのを目にした。

トランプ氏は、米国がエヌビディアに対し、同社が手がける２番目に高性能なＡＩチップであるＨ２００プロセッサーの中国への輸出を認め、その販売に２５％の手数料を課すと述べていた。

FAST

Nov 16 : A petition calling for Jensen Huang to be reinstated as Nvidia CEO has drawn more than 178,000 signatures, including names of prominent Silicon Valley figures, four days after he resigned following revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy.
The "Stand With Jensen" campaign listed Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX and Tesla, Replit CEO Amjad Masad and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney among its signatories.
Nvidia shares pared early losses but remained more than 1 per cent lower after US President Donald Trump said he would not mind seeing Huang return as CEO.
"I think he learned a big lesson," Trump said.

The website showed more than 8,400 signatories identified themselves as current Nvidia employees and nearly 90,000 as shareholders. It cautioned that professional affiliations were self-reported and had not been independently verified.
"We are current and former NVIDIA employees, partners, shareholders, and supporters. We write with gratitude for Jensen Huang and with a clear demand to the Board: bring Jensen back while an independent investigation establishes the facts," an open letter on the website said.
The campaign comes as some prominent investors also urge Nvidia's board not to rush to replace Huang. Atreides Management's Gavin Baker and Altimeter Capital Management CEO Brad Gerstner said in an open letter that the board should wait until all the facts were known.
Huang stepped down on Thursday after reports of alleged affairs with employees, including one who reported directly to him, plunging the AI chip heavyweight into crisis and sending shockwaves through an industry he helped bankroll.
Corporate boards have previously removed chief executives over relationships with employees. McDonald's fired Steve Easterbrook in 2019 over a consensual relationship with an employee that violated company policy, while Intel CEO Brian Krzanich resigned in 2018 after a similar policy breach.
But the episode also highlights the challenges boards can face when ousting high-profile executives who retain strong employee and investor backing. OpenAI reinstated Sam Altman as CEO in November 2023, just days after his removal triggered an employee revolt and opposition from investors.
The turmoil at Nvidia comes as the company is taking on growing strategic importance in Washington.
Trump's reported trades this year suggest he held between $13 million and $62 million in Nvidia stock as of the end of August, the Washington Post reported on Monday, citing a review of his financial disclosures.
The Trump administration also plans to designate Nvidia and more than two dozen other AI companies as "national champions," the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has called for Nvidia to appoint an outsider as its next CEO, saying the company needs a "dramatic shake-up" following Huang's departure.
Nvidia is due to report third-quarter earnings after the market closes on Tuesday.

Source: Reuters

Senator accuses US Commerce Department of failing to stem flow of AI chips to China

This follows remarks by United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent that the Treasury, the Pentagon, the State Department and the US Trade Representative's Office had been in favour of putting Megaspeed, the company at the heart of the Nvidia scandal, on a trade blacklist for months.

FAST

WASHINGTON: The Senate Commerce Committee's top Democrat has accused the Commerce Department of not doing enough to prevent China from obtaining advanced AI chips, saying Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's failure to take action undermined national security.
"America cannot maintain its leadership in AI if the agency responsible for protecting that advantage fails to enforce its own controls," Senator Maria Cantwell said in a Nov 15 letter to Lutnick seen by Reuters.
The letter follows remarks by United States Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent that the Treasury, the Pentagon, the State Department and the US Trade Representative's Office had been in favour of putting Megaspeed, the Singapore company at the heart of the Nvidia scandal, on a trade blacklist for months.
However, the Commerce Department, which is in charge of the list, had not been in favor, Bessent said on Friday.

"Despite these warnings, the Department of Commerce delayed action on repeated national security warnings, putting America's technological advantage in AI at risk," Cantwell said.
Lutnick's failure to use his authority has "undermined America's national security," she also wrote.
A spokesperson for Lutnick declined to comment on the letter.
Megaspeed has been in the spotlight following reports that former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom US authorities suspect of being a Chinese spy.
In October 2025, the New York Times reported that US authorities were investigating whether Megaspeed helped Chinese customers obtain Nvidia computer chips subject to Washington's export controls. China has denied the allegation and Megaspeed has not been found to have violated the rules.
Megaspeed said on Sunday that Alice Huang left the company in August 2025 and that it conducts a "legitimate and lawful business."
Cantwell also said that the Commerce Department had suspended a probe into Megaspeed, and that financial conflicts raise serious questions about whether it was putting business interests ahead of national security.
She noted that the Trump administration had imposed a 25 per cent fee on certain Nvidia chips sold to China, arguing that this created "a perverse financial incentive to approve exports of sensitive American technology."
Cantwell is the latest of a slew of US lawmakers who have called for tougher restrictions on China's access to advanced AI chips in the wake of the scandal.
House Speaker Mike Johnson said on Thursday that the growing consensus in Congress favors new restrictions. Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Democrat from Massachusetts, and Senator Jim Banks, an Indiana Republican, argue export-control decisions with major national security implications should face greater congressional oversight.

Source: Reuters/ao

Nvidia set to deliver first life-after-Huang briefing

FAST

BENGALURU/LONDON, Nov 16 : The sudden departure of Nvidia's influential CEO, Jensen Huang, has shifted attention ahead of the chip giant's quarterly earnings from concerns over narrowing margins and use of cash to more critical questions about its influence across the AI ecosystem.
Huang stepped down last Thursday after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy, plunging the chipmaker into crisis and sending shockwaves across an AI industry he helped bankroll.
Nvidia's finance chief, Colette Kress, is currently interim CEO and its board has said it is in the process of selecting a search firm for the CEO role.
The company is due to report third-quarter earnings after the market closes on Tuesday.

Until this leadership crisis, investors had been obsessing over the sharp fall in the company's market valuation, questioning whether the debt-fuelled AI spending would continue into 2027 and whether its high margins were sustainable.
Now they hope Kress can assuage worries over whether Nvidia can keep up its cutting-edge chip dominance while supporting cloud providers, suppliers and labs with cash and guarantees in the absence of its rock-star CEO. Wall Street analysts are also certain to quiz her on the possibility Huang returns to the helm.
"The earnings itself should be typical, but any comfort we can get on the rest of the business and the management changes is probably the most important piece," said Brian Colello, technology equity analyst at Morningstar Research Services.
"We'll want any early insights on what Nvidia will do in the interim, what they're seeing with customers, what they're seeing with partnerships, finance, government, a lot of questions there. I don't know if we'll get many answers, but we'll want to at least hear the company's statements on those sort of things."
The $4 trillion company, which was until recently the world's most valuable, has blown analysts' expectations consistently.
In the second quarter that ended in July, its revenue more than doubled from a year earlier, gross margins were at 75 per cent and it returned $26 billion to shareholders via buybacks and dividends. It then said it expects revenue of $108 billion, plus or minus 2 per cent, in the third quarter, 70 per cent growth next year and a dip in gross margins because of rising memory costs.
Adjusted profit in the October quarter is expected to be $2.47 per share, compared with $1.30 in the same quarter last year.
Yet its share price has fallen by a third from an October peak, and the price-to-earnings ratio is down to 11 from as high as 40 eight months ago.
"The multiple has been under pressure even prior to Huang's departure. The market is evidently sceptical of those earnings' growth expectations," said Rory Dowie, London-based equity portfolio manager at asset manager Marlborough, who exited his Nvidia positions last week.
"We do believe that Huang's departure puts those earnings more at risk. We prefer to be positioned in the companies looking to take share out of the Nvidia pie. Huang departing perhaps pushes the door a bit more open for the likes of AMD or Broadcom," he said.
BY THE NUMBERS
Dan Morgan, a portfolio manager at Synovus Trust, expects total revenues in the third quarter to be $2 billion to $3 billion above the consensus estimate of $109.08 billion, which would be more than 90 per cent growth over last year.
But he too thinks the biggest question for investors this week is "what does Nvidia need to do to shake off the abundance of uncertainties circling the company to allow the stock break out of the current trading range?"
Among key numbers investors are watching is the contribution of Nvidia's new Vera Rubin data center platform and whether it meets projections that the Rubin GPUs will make up a fifth of the third-quarter revenue.
Another issue investors will seek answers on is Nvidia's willingness to sustain the enormous financing deals that interim CEO Kress is believed to have pushed back against. The deals, including investments in OpenAI and AI infrastructure companies such as Lambda, fed into what some Wall Street critics have deemed a risky, circular AI economy.
By some estimates, Nvidia has more than half a trillion dollars of commitments in the form of various supply and capacity backstops for chip purchases, data center leases and equity investments, which nonetheless are a fraction of firm's market capitalisation.
Max Anderl, a hedge fund manager with SilverSea Asset Management, said besides investor unease over the effective use of cash, it is notable that nearly a third of Nvidia's enormous profits are non-operating profits, implying they come from the mark-to market values of the equity investments.
"If the whole AI story changes, then you have to write down these investments and the whole train would reverse. And that's why I think the stock’s multiple has contracted, long before the exit of its CEO, despite continuous good results."

Source: Reuters

ISLAMABAD, Nov 16 : Pakistan's consumer price inflation is expected to gradually ease towards medium-term target range of 5 per cent to 7 per cent during financial year 2027, the country's central bank said on Monday.
Real GDP growth will remain in the range of 3.5 per cent to 4.5 per cent, the bank said in a yearly report, which added the country's current account deficit was likely to be in range of 0 to 1 per cent of GDP in the financial year.
It projected fiscal deficit to range between 3.0 – 4.0 per cent of the GDP.

items.title: 中国百度、ＡＩクラウド「より持続可能な事業に」　7─9月大幅増収
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［１６日　ロイター］ - 中国の百度（バイドゥ）が１６日発表したが１６日発表した第3・四半期（７─９月）決算は減収となっ...
items.body:
中国百度、ＡＩクラウド「より持続可能な事業に」　7─9月大幅増収
11/16 20:16 配信

百度（バイドゥ）のロゴ、北京のオフィスで3月17日撮影 REUTERS/Florence Lo（ロイター） ［１６日　ロイター］ - 中国の百度（バイドゥ）が１６日発表したが１６日発表した第3・四半期（７─９月）決算は減収となった。人工知能（ＡＩ）クラウドコンピューティング事業は好調だったが、中核のオンライン広告事業の低迷が響いた。

売上高は３０８億１０００万元（４６億２０００万ドル）。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト１５人の予想平均（３０８億６０００万元）とほぼ一致した。

米国預託株式１株当たりの調整後利益は６．７８元と、予想の６．３６元を上回った。コスト減少が寄与した。

企業がＡＩ向け支出を増やす中、同社はクラウドコンピューティング事業の拡大に多額の投資を行っている。

ＡＩ関連事業の売上高は３７％増の１３２億元（１９億８０００万ドル）となった。ＡＩクラウドインフラの売上高は９４％増の８２億元だった。

李彦宏（ロビン・リー）最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は決算説明会で、ＡＩ関連分野への投資が顧客とのより強固で長期的な契約締結に寄与していると述べた。

「クラウドアセットへの投資回収期間は短縮しており、ＡＩクラウドインフラはより健全で持続可能な事業となっている」と述べた。将来の処理能力を確保するため前払いで、より長期の契約を結ぶ顧客が増えているとし、「これにより、将来の需要に対する見通しが改善し、キャッシュフローが支えられている」とした。

一方、中国国内の消費低迷を受けて広告主が予算を削減する中、同社の主軸であるオンライン広告事業は停滞が続いている。オンライン・マーケティング・サービス売上高は２２％減の１１９億元だった。

投資家の間では、百度のＡＩモデル「アーニー」に大幅な改良がないため、ＡＩ分野でアリババやディープシーク、ムーンショットなどに後れを取っているとの懸念がある。経営陣は、厳しい競争環境と同社の検索サービスへのＡＩツール統合が、短期的には引き続き事業の圧迫要因になるとの見方を示した。

ヘンリー・ホー最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は「（ＡＩ検索に対し）積極的なアプローチを取っており、すでにユーザーの利用拡大が見られる。だが、これを収益に結びつけるには時間がかかる。拙速な収益化よりもユーザー体験を優先している」と述べた。

items.body:
対中ＡＩ半導体規制、商務省の取り組み不十分と米議員が批判
11/16 20:14 配信

マリア・キャントウェル上院議員（民主党）、2025年6月3日撮影 REUTERS/Annabelle Gordon（ロイター） David Shepardson

[ワシントン １６日 ロイター] - 米上院商務委員会の民主党トップ、マリア・キャントウェル議員は、中国による先端人工知能（ＡＩ）半導体の入手を阻止するための商務省の取り組みが不十分だと批判した。ラトニック商務長官が措置を講じなかったことで、国家安全保障が損なわれたと主張した。

ラトニック氏に宛てた１５日付の書簡で「ＡＩ分野での優位を守る責任を負う機関が自らの規制を執行しなければ、米国は主導的な地位を維持できない」と述べた。ロイターが書簡を確認した。

ベセント財務長官はこれまでに、エヌビディアを巡るスキャンダルの渦中にあるシンガポール企業メガスピードを貿易上のブラックリストに加えることについて、財務省、国防総省、国務省、米通商代表部が数カ月前から支持していたと発言していた。しかしリストを所管する商務省が賛成していなかったという。

キャントウェル氏は「国家安全保障上の警告が繰り返されたにもかかわらず、商務省は対応を先送りし、ＡＩ分野での米国の技術的優位を危険にさらした」と指摘した。ラトニック氏が権限を行使しなかったことで「米国の国家安全保障が損なわれた」と記した。

米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズは２０２５年１０月、米国の輸出規制の対象となっているエヌビディア製半導体を中国の顧客が入手するのをメガスピードが支援した疑いについて、米当局が調査していると報じた。

キャントウェル氏は商務省がメガスピードへの調査を停止したとし、金銭面での利益相反により、同省が国家安全保障よりもビジネス上の利益を優先していたのではないかという重大な疑問が生じていると述べた。

トランプ政権が中国向けに販売されるエヌビディア製半導体の一部に２５％の手数料を課したことに触れ、これが「米国の機微な技術の輸出を承認するよう促す、ゆがんだ金銭的動機」を生んだと主張した。

items.summary: [フランクフルト １６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は１６日に公表した「金融安定性レビュー」で、ユーロ圏の...
items.body:
ユーロ圏の銀行、アウトソーシングは詐欺よりリスク＝ＥＣＢ
11/16 20:11 配信

フランクフルトの欧州中央銀行本部、2023年撮影 REUTERS/Heiko Becker（ロイター） [フランクフルト １６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）は１６日に公表した「金融安定性レビュー」で、ユーロ圏の銀行にとって、外部プロバイダーの問題は詐欺行為の試みよりも大きな技術的問題の原因となっていると述べた。

• ２０２５年初頭から２６年９月までの間にユーロ圏の銀行で発生した主要なサイバーインシデントのうち、悪意のある行為によるものは比較的少ない割合を占めており、これらのインシデントのほとんどは影響が軽微だったという。

• 対照的に、サイバーインシデントの約５分の１は、銀行が特にＩＴシステムのために利用している第三者プロバイダーに起因するものだった。

• ＥＣＢは、大手プロバイダーへのアウトソーシングは銀行の強靭性を高める可能性があると指摘。これらのプロバイダーは「高度なサイバー能力を備えた最先端のＡＩモデルへの特権的アクセス権をしばしば有しており、それらを機能させるための専門知識も備えている」ため。

• 一方で、こうした大手プロバイダーは欧州連合（ＥＵ）域外に拠点を置く傾向があるため、問題となる「依存関係」が生じている。

• ＥＣＢは、ＡＩを活用した攻撃に対する耐性を高めるためには、銀行、テクノロジー企業、当局間の協調的な取り組みが必要と指摘。これには、万が一利用している銀行が影響を受けた場合に備え、顧客に「十分な現金」を保有するよう促すことも含まれる。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:

[シンガポール １６日 ロイター] - 中国のレアアース（希土類）生産大手２社が収益力を...
items.body:
中国レアアース大手2社の収益力向上、価格高と業界改革が追い風
11/16 20:09 配信

中国国家博物館（北京）でのレアアース展示、3月24日撮影 REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov/File Photo（ロイター） Solomon Cefai

[シンガポール １６日 ロイター] - 中国のレアアース（希土類）生産大手２社が収益力を高めている。鉱物価格の上昇と、業界の混乱を抑えようとする中国政府の取り組みが追い風となっている。

中国北方稀土（ＣＮＲＥ）の第３・四半期決算に基づくと、１─９月の純利益は３６億５０００万元（５億４７１９万ドル）と、前年同期の２倍超に増えた。

中国稀土集団資源科技も、１─９月の利益が４億０８００万元と２倍超となった。

両社とも通期利益はアナリスト予想を上回るペースで推移している。

中国が２０２５年４月に導入した輸出規制の対象外である軽レアアースの価格が堅調で、規制対象のレアアースの出荷減少を補った。このため、国内大手に対する規制の影響が抑えられている。

シティのアナリスト、アンナ・ワン氏は「供給側の改革で業界の規律が改善し、価格が下支えされている」と述べた。その結果レアアース価格が上がったことが、中国のレアアース生産会社の好業績の「主な要因」だと分析した。

中国は数十年にわたり、多くの主要産業を悩ませてきた供給過剰を防ぐため、レアアースの生産枠を設け、企業の統合を促してきた。２４年に生産枠の割り当て先を従来の６社からＣＮＲＥと中国稀土集団資源の２社に絞った。ワン氏は集約によって生産量の監督が強化されたと述べた。

Nov 16 : Papa John's wants AI to have a look at your pizza before you take your first bite.
The chain is offering a free pizza to customers who send in a photo of their delivered order, along with some feedback, as part of an AI-based quality-control campaign to help make sure each of its pizzas is properly cooked and cut.
CEO Todd Penegor told Reuters in an interview that the promotion will help the chain to improve pizza quality across its franchised restaurants — addressing inconsistencies that he said have become the “Achilles’ heel” of the brand.
The aim, Penegor said, is to develop a system that can mirror the chain’s in-store quality-control cameras, which use AI to check that cheese is not burnt, pepperoni slices are cut smoothly and the outer crust is shaped like “a beautiful breadstick.”

But those in-store cameras are only installed in a few hundred locations out of the chain’s 6,000 worldwide, he said. The user-submitted images could allow the company to apply image-based quality control far more widely and cheaply, although they are not yet as accurate as the in-store cameras.
The company has a “huge dashboard with all of the pictures that are coming in,” as well as user-submitted feedback, he said, adding that the promotion generated thousands of photos for the company in the first few days after it began on November 9. It will last until November 20.
Penegor said the technology was relatively cheap to develop in-house and that it built on existing AI technology the company has developed in partnership with Google Cloud.
The company reported a 6.5 per cent decline in quarterly same-store sales on November 5. Penegor said feedback from the promotion will help the chain decide which fixes to prioritize and give franchisees a clear view of where their restaurants may fall short.

items.summary: In a strike notice served on IDBI Bank MD and CEO, the UFIOE said the strike would be observed across all branches and offices of the bank nationwide ...
items.body:
Home / Industry / News / IDBI Bank employee unions call one-day nationwide strike on December 3

IDBI Bank employee unions call one-day nationwide strike on December 3 In a strike notice served on IDBI Bank MD and CEO, the UFIOE said the strike would be observed across all branches and offices of the bank nationwide

Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Nov 17 2026 | 12:00 AM IST

Listen to This Article

IDBI Bank employee unions have called a one-day nationwide strike on December 3 to protest against the proposed sale of the bank to Canada-based Fairfax Financial Holdings.
The United Forum of IDBI Officers and Employees (UFIOE), comprising the All India IDBI Officers' Association (AIIDBIOA) and the All India Industrial Development Bank Employees' Association (AIIDBEA), called the strike.
Earlier this month, the UFIOE had gone on a two-day nationwide strike to oppose the proposed sale of a majority stake to Fairfax.
In a strike notice served on IDBI Bank MD and CEO, the UFIOE said the strike would be observed across all branches and offices of the bank nationwide.
  The unions have demanded that the government and LIC stop the proposed sale of IDBI Bank to Fairfax Financial Holdings, describing the bank as a national asset.
Also Read

Fairfax likely to exit IIFL Finance to fund its acquisition of IDBI Bank

Rahul Gandhi attacks govt on IDBI bank sale row; FM Sitharaman hits back

Cong used banks as 'personal entities': Sitharaman amid IDBI divestment row

Rahul Gandhi backs IDBI Bank staff, questions sale to Canada's Fairfax

Govt defends IDBI Bank valuation, says process added ₹3,917 cr to deal value

The unions have also warned they will intensify their agitation if their demands are not met, including strikes lasting more than one day and even an indefinite strike without further notice.
The Opposition, led by Congress, has also raised concerns over the valuation of IDBI Bank. The Congress had alleged that the IDBI Bank disinvestment was a 'scam' and demanded that the sale of the bank to a foreign company be halted and a Joint Parliamentary Committee be constituted to probe the entire process.
Congress general secretary in-charge of communications Jairam Ramesh claimed that a foreign company is acquiring IDBI Bank from the government using funds that belong to the bank itself.
"This is yet another major scam by the Modi government, which warrants an investigation. We demand that the process of selling IDBI Bank to a foreign company be halted," Ramesh had said.
The Central government and LIC hold 45.48 per cent and 49.24 per cent equity shares, respectively, in IDBI Bank.
The government on October 14 approved the sale of a 60.72 per cent stake in IDBI Bank to Canada's Fairfax Financial Holdings for about Rs 53,000 crore (USD 5.5 billion), in what would be the largest foreign investment in an Indian bank and a major milestone in the country's long-delayed banking privatisation drive.
Fairfax will be the strategic buyer of the government's 30.48 per cent stake, valued at about Rs 26,620 crore, and the 30.24 per cent stake held by LIC, valued at about Rs 26,440 crore.
Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa-led Fairfax will pay Rs 81 per share, higher than the benchmark fair value of Rs 75.99 determined by two independent valuation agencies.
The strategic transaction of IDBI Bank is expected to be completed by the end of the current financial year, subject to regulatory clearance from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

ＡＩが金融にもたらすリスク、バーＦＲＢ理事が多角的に指摘
11/16 19:03 配信

ＦＲBのバー理事。2月にニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） [１６日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）が取引やサイバーセキュリティー、消費者・投資家保護にもたらし得るさまざまなリスクを指摘した。ＦＲＢが先週公表した報告書では、ＡＩが金融の安定に及ぼすリスクへの懸念が急速に高まっていることが示されており、同氏はこうした懸念をさらに掘り下げた。

１３日公表の最新の金融安定報告書に向けた調査では、回答者の約８７％がＡＩを米国の金融システムにとっての主要なリスクに挙げた。サイバー攻撃や複雑なＡＩ関連の資金調達、ＡＩ関連の利益成長鈍化が株式市場全体の下落を引き起こす可能性への懸念が示された。

バー氏は１６日、これらの懸念の一部について詳しく説明するとともに、さらに複数のリスクを挙げた。取引でＡＩモデルへの依存が高まれば、市場参加者が一斉に同じ行動を取り、市場に混乱をもたらす可能性があると指摘。自己学習するアルゴリズムが相場を操縦し、市場を不安定化させる恐れもあるとした。

また、「個人顧客の口座で操作を実行しようとする」ＡＩエージェントについて、銀行が、そのＡＩエージェントに顧客が実際に権限を与えているかどうかを確認できない可能性を挙げた。正当な権限を持つＡＩエージェントでも、個人顧客に代わって極めて高速に行動することで取り付け騒ぎを加速させ、従来の安全策では対応しきれなくなる恐れがあるとした。

ＡＩを利用するサイバー攻撃者や、制御を離れたＡＩエージェントが金融システムの脆弱性を突くサイバーリスクも指摘した。

バー氏は、ＡＩ開発企業がモデルについて「適切に制御され、数値面でも法律面でも正確で、説明可能かつ再現可能」であることを確保するのに苦慮していると述べた。

「ＡＩが消費者向け融資における偏りを強めるリスクを低減する必要がある。また、金融市場でのＡＩ利用によって生じ得るリスクにも備えなければならない。これには共謀や相場操縦、市場の大幅な変動、さらにはシステミックリスクを引き起こす取引戦略が含まれる」と語った。

イタリアのミラノでの講演に向けて用意された今回の発言は、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長がサンフランシスコ連銀で開かれる会議で開会のあいさつを行う数時間前に公表された。同会議では、ＡＩ開発企業や企業幹部、学識者らが、ＡＩが生産性や雇用、経済全般に及ぼす影響を議論する予定だ。

バー氏は講演原稿で、金融政策や経済の見通しには言及しなかった。

items.title: Vitamin B12 may hold key to treating a rare genetic disorder: Study
items.summary: Scientists discovered that vitamin B12 largely reversed developmental abnormalities in worms carrying a genetic mutation linked to Verheij syndrome, a rare disorder that causes growth problems and ...
items.body:
Vitamin B12 may hold key to treating a rare genetic disorder: Study  Scientists discovered that vitamin B12 largely reversed developmental abnormalities in worms carrying a genetic mutation linked to Verheij syndrome, a rare disorder that causes growth problems and developmental delays, as per a study published in the ScienceDaily website. 
ANI | Updated: 16-11-2026 23:22 IST | Created: 16-11-2026 23:22 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Scientists discovered that vitamin B12 largely reversed developmental abnormalities in worms carrying a genetic mutation linked to Verheij syndrome, a rare disorder that causes growth problems and developmental delays, as per a study published on the ScienceDaily website. Similar metabolic changes were identified in human patients, raising the possibility that this common vitamin could inspire new treatments for rare genetic diseases.
A surprising discovery involving vitamin B12 could open new possibilities for understanding and potentially treating rare genetic disorders. Researchers found that the vitamin can correct developmental problems in tiny worms carrying a genetic mutation associated with Verheij syndrome, a rare human condition that causes developmental delays, impaired growth, and short stature. According to the website, the findings center on a cellular process called RNA splicing, which helps prepare the genetic instructions cells use to produce proteins. During splicing, unnecessary portions of messenger RNA are removed, and the remaining sections are joined together in the correct order. When this process goes wrong, it can disrupt essential cellular functions and contribute to serious developmental disorders.
Mutations in genes responsible for splicing can cause conditions such as Verheij syndrome. To better understand the effects of these genetic changes, scientists investigated how a related mutation affects growth and metabolism in a laboratory model. Vitamin B12 Reverses Developmental Defects in Worms
The discovery emerged from experiments involving C. elegans, a tiny roundworm commonly used in biological research. The researchers were initially searching for previously unknown genes that influence lifespan when they began examining a mutation in a gene involved in RNA splicing. The same gene is associated with Verheij syndrome in humans. Worms carrying the mutation developed problems resembling important features of the human disorder. Their growth slowed considerably, and they remained smaller than normal.
To investigate why this happened, the scientists conducted genetic screens and analyzed the worms' metabolism. They discovered that the mutation disrupted specific metabolic pathways that depend on vitamin B12 and are essential for healthy growth and normal cellular activity. The researchers then tested whether providing additional vitamin B12 could counteract these changes. Remarkably, the treatment restored the affected metabolic processes to normal and corrected the developmental abnormalities associated with the mutation, as per the website.
"We were surprised to find that a change in a fundamental process of RNA processing had such a targeted effect on vitamin B12-dependent metabolism," says Jonathan Kölschbach, first author of the study. "Even more exciting was that we were able to largely correct the consequences of this change in the worm model using vitamin B12," added Jonathan Kölschbach, as quoted by the website.
Could Vitamin B12 Help Treat a Rare Genetic Disorder? To explore whether their findings might also apply to people, the researchers examined publicly available datasets from human cells. They also worked with Hormos Dafsari, a neuropediatrician at the University Hospital Cologne, to collect blood samples from patients diagnosed with Verheij syndrome.
These investigations uncovered evidence of similar metabolic changes in humans, suggesting that the vitamin B12-related pathways affected in the worms may also play a role in the human disorder. Although the results are promising, researchers have not yet established whether vitamin B12 supplementation can improve symptoms in people with Verheij syndrome. Additional studies will be necessary to determine whether the benefits observed in worms can be translated into a treatment for patients.
The discovery also raises a broader possibility. Metabolic disruptions may contribute more substantially to diseases caused by faulty RNA splicing than scientists previously recognised. Understanding these connections could help researchers identify new therapeutic strategies, potentially extending beyond Verheij syndrome to other rare genetic conditions. (ANI)

MILAN: An Italian court has placed the European unit of British bank Revolut under judicial administration after finding that convicted mobsters and money launderers had funnelled illicit cash through its accounts.
The one-year measure targets Lithuania-based Revolut Bank UAB, which operates in Italy through a local branch. In a 39-page ruling reviewed by Reuters, the court cited "serious deficiencies" in the lender's anti-money laundering controls.
The Milan court said inadequate safeguards had enabled 24 people, either under investigation or already convicted of various crimes, to conceal financial flows totalling €41.9 million (US$46.2 million) between 2021 and 2026.
During that time, rival lenders filed 265 suspicious transaction reports regarding the 24 suspects, while Revolut Bank UAB filed none, the ruling said.

Revolut is not under criminal investigation, and the oversight applies exclusively to its Italian operations, with no expected disruption to retail or commercial services.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
As in previous cases involving companies in sectors such as fashion and logistics, the judicial administration measure is preventive rather than punitive. It is designed to protect a company while restoring internal compliance and control systems aimed at forestalling future criminal conduct.
ALLEGED SHORTCOMINGS WERE NOT ISOLATED, JUDGES SAY Milan prosecutors and the court attributed what they described as negligent conduct to the bank, alleging that it had failed to implement adequate controls to avoid illicit activity.
Revolut Bank UAB, the group's licensed entity in Lithuania that operates the Italian branch, is ultimately owned by UK-based Revolut Group Holdings Ltd.
Prosecutors said the Revolut group has more than 50 million customers worldwide and over 5 million in Italy, making it the country's fifth-largest banking provider by client numbers and its top foreign bank.
The court said the alleged shortcomings in controls were not isolated incidents but were "embedded in a stable management model, repeatedly applied over time", which prevented authorities from identifying and freezing illicit funds.
GAINING AN UNFAIR ADVANTAGE In their filing, prosecutors said the bank had been used as a "financial reservoir" for serious criminals, giving it an unfair advantage over rival institutions equipped with adequate anti-money laundering systems.
The court appointed two judicial administrators tasked with broad oversight and inspection powers, which could be expanded if the bank failed to cooperate fully or if further critical issues emerged.
The measure will remain in place for one year, subject to periodic reviews of its implementation.
Under the ruling, Revolut must execute a 15-point remediation plan. It has five days to appoint an internal liaison officer and 60 days to submit an action plan addressing its compliance failures.
The administrators are required to file a preliminary report within 30 days and a comprehensive assessment of Revolut's anti-money laundering controls within 90 days.
ECONOMY MINISTRY ASSESSING POSSIBLE PENALTIES The judicial action stems from a 2024 inspection by Milan's Guardia di Finanza police into Revolut Digital Assets Europe (formerly called RT Digital Securities Cyprus), the entity that handles cryptocurrency services for European users.
In a report completed in December 2024, financial police alleged more than one million violations of customer due-diligence and data-retention rules, alongside 60 failures to flag suspicious transactions.
The report was sent to Italy's Economy Ministry, which is responsible for imposing administrative sanctions.
The ministry has not formally opened sanction proceedings because the deadline for Revolut to file objections runs until 2027, two sources with direct knowledge of the matter said.

items.body:
Bangladesh becomes Development Finance Corporation-eligible country Bangladesh’s new eligibility status creates an important opportunity for DFC to help address the country’s substantial economic development needs by mobilising private investment, the statement said.
ANI | Updated: 16-11-2026 23:05 IST | Created: 16-11-2026 23:05 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The US International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) today announced that projects in Bangladesh are now eligible for DFC financing, the US Embassy in Dhaka said in a statement on Monday. DFC’s investments in South Asia serve as a stabilising force by supporting energy, critical infrastructure, and technology projects that strengthen our alliances and protect the region’s sovereignty, it added.
Bangladesh’s new eligibility status creates an important opportunity for DFC to help address the country’s substantial economic development needs by mobilising private investment, the statement said. Expanded access to DFC financing and risk-mitigation tools will help bridge critical investment gaps and advance projects that might otherwise face financing constraints, it said.
These investments will spur economic growth by developing critical infrastructure, creating jobs, expanding access to essential services, and strengthening local businesses, it said. DFC’s support is valuable in helping commercially viable, development-focused projects overcome financing constraints or perceived risks that would otherwise deter private investment, the US Embassy said.
“Bangladesh’s eligibility for DFC financing marks an important opportunity to deepen our economic partnership and mobilise private investment that delivers lasting growth. By supporting projects that strengthen critical infrastructure, we can unlock economic opportunity for Bangladesh while advancing U.S. strategic interests,” said Ben Black, DFC CEO. “The United States believes that promoting open economies and reciprocal trade will spur economic growth in Bangladesh, and th Agreement on Reciprocal Trade is our public commitment to supporting Bangladesh through this process. DFC financing can play an important role in making that vision a reality – spurring further prosperity in both of our countries,” said Brent T. Christensen, US Ambassador to Bangladesh.
Home to more than half the world’s population and some of its fastest-growing economies, the Indo-Pacific offers significant opportunities for strategic US investment. DFC is committed to helping American businesses expand their presence in the region, mobilizing private capital to advance economic growth rooted in free-market principles and strengthening US  economic partnerships, the statement said. The U.S. International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) is the international investment arm of the United States Government and central to US economic statecraft. DFC mobilises private capital to advance U.S. foreign policyand economic development. (ANI)

MOSCOW: Ukraine fired hundreds of drones at Russia overnight, aiming towards Moscow and hitting a symbolic bridge that links the annexed Crimean peninsula to Russia.
The strike on the bridge appeared to inflict only minor damage, though drew an angry response from Russian-installed officials.
Ukraine launched 1,336 drones in the barrage, Moscow's defence ministry said in a statement - the second-highest daily figure so far this year, according to an AFP tally of official Russian statements.
The barrage came days before a summit in Shenzhen between President Vladimir Putin, US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. US officials say Russia's war against Ukraine is not expected to be a focus of the talks.

"The enemy has hit the Crimea bridge," Crimean's Russian-installed governor Sergey Aksyonov wrote on Telegram. "As a result, traffic will be restricted, likely until the afternoon."
He did not say whether anyone was killed or wounded in the strike. Social media channels close to the Russian army indicated no serious damage had been sustained in the attack.
The bridge has been a key target for Ukraine since Russia launched its offensive in February 2022.
It has been struck several times, including an October 2022 blast in which an explosive-packed truck was detonated on the bridge, causing months of disruption.
Around 600 of the drones were intercepted on approach to the Russian capital, Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said.
The interceptions came hours after Ukrainian forces struck a major Russian petrochemical plant, an oil refinery and a military production site.
Kyiv says its retaliatory strikes are justified retribution for Moscow's own missile and drone barrages of its cities and energy grid -- attacks that have killed hundreds of civilians and regularly knock out power and heating for millions.
"WORLD PEACE" Diplomatic efforts on ending the almost five-year war have so far gone nowhere.
After a fresh round of talks in Abu Dhabi last week, Russian President Vladimir Putin reiterated his hardline territorial demands and said any deployment of foreign troops would be seen in Moscow as a "continuation of war".
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the United States had proposed Kyiv ceding some territory in exchange for being given NATO membership .
Moscow has repeatedly said it will not accept Ukraine being admitted to the US-led alliance.
Against that backdrop, China confirmed on Monday (Nov 16) that Xi would hold talks with Trump and Putin in Shenzhen on Nov 19 on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit.
The Kremlin and White House had previously confirmed the meeting.
Beijing said the trio would discuss "world peace".
Trump has said he intends to discuss denuclearisation and the Iran war.
He is not expected to discuss Russia's war against Ukraine in the trilateral talks, according to US officials.
Zelensky has warned that the Shenzhen meeting risks becoming a 21st-century version of the 1945 Yalta conference, where major powers could attempt to redraw spheres of influence without smaller countries at the table.

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のブイチッチ副総裁。ベルリンで９月撮影。 REUTERS/Annegret Hilse（ロイター） [フランクフルト １６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のブイチッチ副総裁は１６日、ユーロ圏の金融安定リスクの中で、人工知能（ＡＩ）と政府債務への懸念が「極めて際立っている」と述べ、政策当局者が注意を払う必要があると指摘した。

フランクフルトでの講演で、ＡＩは以前、株価のバリュエーションの問題とみられていたが、今では債券・株式市場やサイバーセキュリティー、業務の安全性にまで影響が及ぶシステミックな懸念に変わったと述べた。

「市場で価格が修正されるリスクは和らぐどころか一段と高まっている。それに加え、外部資金の調達先が株式市場から債券市場へ広がっていることや、エクスポージャーの集中、ＡＩ導入の加速、サイバー攻撃の可能性など、さまざまな要因が金融システム全体の安定を脅かすＡＩ関連リスクを生んでいる」と分析した。

米大手テクノロジー企業は２０３０年までに５兆５０００億ドルの資金を必要としている。ブイチッチ氏は、これに伴い社債や株式の発行が増えているが、不透明な簿外の資金調達や、資金を循環させる金融取引も生まれていると指摘した。

また「ＡＩシステムの能力と自律性が高まるにつれ、サイバー攻撃は大規模化、高速化、高度化している」とし「ソーシャルエンジニアリング攻撃も効果を増している」と述べた。

金融機関が防御のためにＡＩを活用する際には、コストの増大や制約の強まりに直面する可能性があるため、こうした傾向は攻撃側に優位に働く恐れがあるとした。

政府債務を巡っては、借り入れコストの上昇に低い潜在成長率が重なれば、財政がさらに圧迫され、多額の債務を抱える国々への懸念が再燃する可能性があると述べた。「同時に、ＡＩ投資ブームに伴う巨額の資金需要により、公的部門と民間部門の借り手の間で資金の奪い合いが起きる可能性が懸念される」と続けた。

items.title: アングル：尽きる「頼れる安全資産」、米国債や金の値動き不安定
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Karen Brettell

[ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] - 今月に入って株価が急落した際、投資家はここ数十年...
items.body:
アングル：尽きる「頼れる安全資産」、米国債や金の値動き不安定
11/16 17:50 配信

金地金。2025年10月、ロンドンで撮影。 REUTERS/Hiba Kola（ロイター） Karen Brettell

[ニューヨーク １６日 ロイター] - 今月に入って株価が急落した際、投資家はここ数十年来の常とう手段である米国債や日本円への買い入れに動いた。しかし、最近の売りにより、ある深刻化する問題が浮き彫りになった。それはポートフォリオのクッションとなるはずの資産が、投資家が最も必要とする時に必ずしも機能するとは限らないということだ。

２０２５年４月、米国の関税導入への懸念から株が売られたが、米国債は例年のようなクッションの役割を果たさなかった。投資家がインフレ、財政リスク、市場の流動性逼迫を懸念したため、長期債も株式と同様に売られ、１０年物利回りは急上昇した。２月２８日に始まった米国・イスラエルとイランとの戦争も同様の動きをもたらした。インフレが加速するとの懸念から、原油価格が急騰し、債券利回りが上昇した。

金相場も同様に不安定な動きを見せている。１０月下旬には株式市場とともに下落し、テクニカルの支持線を割り込み、１年ぶりの安値を記録した。

「頼れる安全資産が尽きつつある」と、スタンダードチャータード銀行のＧ１０為替調査グローバル責任者兼北米マクロ戦略責任者であるスティーブ・エンゲランダー氏は述べた。

安全資産は、市場が下落した際に価値を維持・上昇する傾向がある。投資家は、ポートフォリオの他の部分で生じた損失を相殺するためにこれらを購入する。

ポジションはファンダメンタルズと同じくらい重要だ。エンゲランダー氏によれば、ショック発生後の最も強力な安全資産とは、単に投資家がショートポジションだったため、やむを得ず買い戻さざるを得なくなる資産である場合もあるという。

＜米国債に追加的リスク＞

米国債は依然として世界最大かつ最も流動性の高い市場であり、投資家は危機の際には長年にわたり逃避先としてきた。しかし、脅威がインフレや米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融引き締めである場合、債券は株式と同様に値下がりする可能性がある。

ＦＨＮファイナンシャルのマクロストラテジスト、ウィル・コンパーノール氏は、昨年の米国の関税発表を巡るボラティリティーにより、米国債の魅力が失われたかどうかを判断するのは困難だったと指摘。「米国売り」取引のうわさは、国際的な取引フローでは有意な形で現れなかったという。

一方、フランスの財政懸念に起因するボラティリティーなどの最近の事態は、米国債が「依然として安全資産としての地位を維持している」ことを示すと説明。「リスク回避ムードが高まれば、米国債は魅力的だ。しかし、インフレや地政学的リスクが生じれば、安全な資産はほとんどない」。

デューク大学フクア・スクール・オブ・ビジネスのキャンベル・ハーべイ教授（金融学）は、米国債を「世界における安全資産の指標」と表現。しかし、株式と米国債の動きはますます連動するようになっており、株式６０％、債券４０％というベンチマーク・ポートフォリオは「大きな打撃」を受けているという。

「歴史的には信頼できるものだった。しかし、分散投資によるメリットは減少している」と話す。米国の借入規模――４０兆ドルの債務、年間約２兆ドルの財政赤字、年間１兆１０００億ドルの利払い――にも言及し、米国債には今や追加的なリスクが伴うとする。

＜金の役割「大きく変化」＞

金が「安全資産」として評価されるのは、長期保有を前提としているからだ。ハーべイ教授は、金は「極めて長期、つまり数世紀というスパンでは」非常に信頼性が高いが、短期ではそうではないと述べた。

金の年率換算ボラティリティーは１５％を超えており、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００指数と同程度だ。株式との相関は３─５年の期間ではほぼゼロに近いが、これは平均値であり短期的には大きく逸脱する可能性を指摘。同氏の調査によると、インフレ率の上方サプライズは通常、市場の低迷と関連しており、そうした局面では金価格も下落する可能性がある。

スタンダードチャータードのコモディティー調査担当グローバル責任者スキ・クーパー氏は、金の役割は「大きく変化した」と指摘。投資家は、極端な状況下で活用できる高品質で流動性の高い資産として、金をますます重視している。株式市場の急落がマージンコールを引き起こした場合、特に１月まで過去最高値を更新し続けていた金については、売却の対象として真っ先に挙げられると語った。

クーパー氏は、より長期的な保有期間においては、構造的な要因が依然として存在し、その要因には、２２年以降の中央銀行による過去最高の買い入れや、世界的な債務問題、ドル離れ、通貨の価値低下への懸念が含まれる。

＜戦略の組み合わせ＞

エンゲランダー氏は、どの通貨にも弱点があると指摘する。

スイスフランは割高で、ユーロは政治的・経済的な課題に直面している。ポンドは好調だったが、労働党政権はここ数年のどの英国政府よりも左寄りの立場にあると評価。円はパフォーマンスにばらつきがあるが、市場のボラティリティーが原油価格に起因しない限り、安全資産として魅力的になり得る。日本はエネルギーを輸入に依存しているため、円は原油価格の影響を受けやすい。

ドルは他の多くの通貨よりも高い安全性と利回りを提供している。投資家は米国債に資金を投入し、「４．５％の利息を受け取り」、ボラティリティーが収まった後にどこに投資するかを決定することができる。同氏は「消去法的にはそれがおそらく安全資産の中でも最も安全な選択肢」だとした。

ハーべイ氏は、単一の資産で「あらゆる状況下で信頼できるヘッジ」となるものは存在しないと指摘。金や米国債は防御的なポートフォリオの一部で、コモディティーやその他の実物資産、インフレ連動型米国債も、アクティブ戦略と併せて役割を果たすと語る。例えば、質の高い企業をロングとし質の低い企業をショートにする「クオリティー戦略」は、大幅な下落局面でも損失を最小限に抑えられる可能性がある。「トレンドフォロー戦略」は売り局面で良好なパフォーマンスを発揮する。

これらはいずれも単独では確実に機能するものではないものの、これらを組み合わせることで、「防御型ポートフォリオが実際に機能する可能性を高めることができる」と述べた。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [上海 １６日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は下落して終了。ＡＩ（人工知能）相場の上昇持続性に対する懸念がセンチメン...
items.body:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国株16カ月ぶりの安値付近、ＡＩハードウエアに売り　ハンセン指数は上昇
11/16 17:42 配信

[上海 １６日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は下落して終了。ＡＩ（人工知能）相場の上昇持続性に対する懸念がセンチメントを冷やし、ハードウエア株が下落した。国内経済の弱さを示す新たな兆候も相まって、２０２５年７月以来の安値付近で推移した。

ＣＳＩ３００指数と上海総合指数はいずれも０．９％安で取引を終えた。香港のハンセン指数は０．５％高となった。

中国のＡＩハードウエア関連株の下落は、アジアの同業他社に追随する形となった。

５Ｇ通信指数は７．５％急落し、１年ぶりの安値を記録。上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け株式市場「科創板」の科創板５０指数は５．２％下落した。

ViaBTCのチーフアナリスト、ジェフ・コー氏は、エヌビディアを巡る騒動が中国の半導体メーカーにとって分水嶺となる可能性があると指摘。「もし米国がこの騒動を受けて輸出規制を強化すれば、中国国内のＡＩチップやコンピューティングインフラへの投資が加速する可能性がある」と述べた。

半面、ＣＳＩ３００金融指数は１．５％上昇し、生活必需品株指数は１．２％上昇した。

items.body:
訂正-みずほ証・ＳＭＢＣ日興証、上半期好調　金利上昇で債券販売が拡大
11/16 17:38 配信

円紙幣。10月撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） (第２段落の過去最高を純利益ではなく経常利益として訂正します。)

Miho Uranaka

[東京 １６日 ロイター] - みずほ証券とＳＭＢＣ日興証券ホールディングスが１６日に発表した２０２６年度４－９月期（上期）決算は、ともに投資銀行業務や資産運用関連ビジネスが好調で、利益を押し上げた。金利上昇を背景に個人の債券投資需要が高まったほか、企業の旺盛な資金調達ニーズが収益を押し上げた。

みずほ証券の純利益（米拠点含む）は同１４％増の１２０２億円だった。経常利益は同１５％増の１５２７億円で、半期ベースで過去最高を更新した（訂正）。投資銀行部門では日米のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）や債券・株式引受業務が伸長し、トレーディングなどのグローバルマーケッツ部門でも日米の株式関連業務が好調だった。

７─９月期では債券トレーディングにおいて、米中間選挙などを挟み様子見姿勢が強まる中、顧客フローが減少したことから、純利益は前年同期比１７．７％減となった。

ただし、上野哲・最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は会見で、足元でも、企業の資金需要について「非常に強い状態」と述べ、成長投資や事業再編を背景に案件パイプラインが積み上がっているとの認識を示した。また、金利上昇を受けて個人向け国債や社債への需要が高まり、リテール部門の収益増加につながっていると説明した。

ＳＭＢＣ日興証券ＨＤについては、前年同期に政策保有株売却益を計上していた反動で純利益は１３％減の６４３億円となったものの、本業収益は拡大した。営業利益は８１％増の８５８億円となり、ＳＭＢＣグループ入り以降で上期として過去最高を記録した。

財務を担当する後藤歩・常務執行役員は、個人の債券投資ニーズについて「非常に高まっている」と述べ、円債販売額が前年同期比で倍増したと説明。特に個人向け国債の３年債が伸びたという。また、社債償還の増加を背景に発行体側の資金調達需要も強く、「健全な需給が成り立っている」と指摘した。

海外ＦＩＣＣ（債券・為替・商品）の立て直しが引き続き課題となっている。国内では円金利商品や為替デリバティブ関連の収益が改善し、グローバル・マーケッツ部門の赤字幅は縮小したものの、海外では金利上昇や市場変動の影響を受けて収益が伸び悩み、第２四半期も営業赤字が続いた。同社は顧客フロー中心のビジネスモデルへの転換に加え、海外拠点を含めたリスク管理体制の強化を進めている。

items.body:

UN ready to support any denuclearisation effort from US, China, Russia talks

The UN has long advocated nuclear disarmament, warning that rising geopolitical tension and growing rivalry among major powers have fuelled global nuclear risks.

UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres speaks during a press conference at the UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Turkey, Nov 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Umit Bektas)

MANILA: The United Nations is prepared to support any denuclearisation effort that may arise from this week's summit meeting between China, Russia and the United States, UN chief Antonio Guterres said on Monday (Nov 16), despite a lack of certainty about such an outcome.
"If there is a denuclearisation programme, we are ready to be fully engaged in that and contribute to make it a success," UN Secretary-General Guterres said in Manila, where he is attending a summit of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.
"This is what we would like to see," he added at a press conference. "It's not yet guaranteed that we will get there." 
US President Donald Trump will raise efforts to reduce nuclear arms at a Nov 19 meeting in China with his Russian and Chinese counterparts Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping, the White House said last week.

Trump's four-day trip to Asia includes a stop on Tuesday in the Philippines, to meet ASEAN leaders and attend his first meeting of the Quad grouping of Indo-Pacific powers Australia, India, Japan and the US, in their first such gathering in two years.
Putin, Xi and Trump are set to meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen.
Trump's insistence that the first-of-its-kind meeting of the three leaders focus on nuclear arms reductions has riled Beijing, which has for years resisted direct engagement with Washington about its nuclear programme.
China has said it was more appropriate for Russia and the US to speak directly because of their large arsenals.
The UN has long advocated nuclear disarmament, warning that rising geopolitical tension and growing rivalry among major powers have fuelled global nuclear risks.
Guterres also reiterated the UN's call for a diplomatic solution to end the US-Israeli war against Iran, which Trump is also expected to raise at the summit.  
"What we need in relation to the situation in the Middle East, and in particular in relation to Iran and the United States, is a serious diplomatic process of negotiation to end this neither peace nor war that you are living in with devastating consequences to the global economy," he added.

items.title: アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（16日）
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: 中国株式市場は下落して終了。ＡＩ（人工知能）相場の上昇持続性に対する懸念がセンチメントを冷やし、ハードウエア株が下落した...
items.body:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（16日）
11/16 16:44 配信

中国株式市場は下落して終了。ＡＩ（人工知能）相場の上昇持続性に対する懸念がセンチメントを冷やし、ハードウエア株が下落した。国内経済の弱さを示す新たな兆候も相まって、２０２５年７月以来の安値付近で推移した。

ＣＳＩ３００指数と上海総合指数はいずれも０．９％安で取引を終えた。香港のハンセン指数は０．５％高となった。

中国のＡＩハードウエア関連株の下落は、アジアの同業他社に追随する形となった。

５Ｇ通信指数は７．５％急落し、１年ぶりの安値を記録。上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け株式市場「科創板」の科創板５０指数は５．２％下落した。

ViaBTCのチーフアナリスト、ジェフ・コー氏は、エヌビディアを巡る騒動が中国の半導体メーカーにとって分水嶺となる可能性があると指摘。「もし米国がこの騒動を受けて輸出規制を強化すれば、中国国内のＡＩチップやコンピューティングインフラへの投資が加速する可能性がある」と述べた。

半面、ＣＳＩ３００金融指数は１．５％上昇し、生活必需品株指数は１．２％上昇した。

中国経済の停滞を示す新たな兆候が見られた。１０月の鉱工業生産は前年比４．８％増と伸びが鈍、小売売上高の伸びも減速し、景気の弱さが改めて示された。

台湾と韓国のハイテク株は急落し、相場を押し下げた。

台湾加権指数は６％安と、韓国の総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）は３．６％安となり、ＭＳＣＩアジア新興国株指数は３％超下落した。

注目材料は１７日のエヌビディアの決算発表と週後半のアンソロピックの上場。

台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）は５．７％下落。韓国のＳＫハイニックスとサムスン電子はそれぞれ７．９％、４．５％急落した。

ＳＫハイニックスは、国内の半導体素材・部品・装置メーカーを支援するため、今後５年間で１兆４０００億ウォン（１０億５０００万ドル）を投じる計画を明らかにした。ＡＩ半導体市場で競争が激化する中、供給網の強化を目指す。

英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は１５日、事情に詳しい関係者の話として、ジェンスン・フアン氏がエヌビディアの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）への復帰を検討し、側近らとその可能性について協議したと報じた。

ソウル以上で売買された９１２銘柄のうち、値上がりは２６３銘柄、値下がりは６１５銘柄だった。海外投資家は１兆３７６１億ウォン相当を売り越した。

シドニー株式市場は３営業日続落して引けた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への懸念がコモディティー価格を圧迫、リスク選好が弱まる中、鉱業株が下げを主導した。

指数への影響が大きい鉱業株指数は２．３％下落し、１週間余りぶりの安値を付けた。他の大半の業種は小幅な値動きにとどまった。

ＫＣＭトレードのチーフ市場アナリスト、ティム・ウォータラー氏は「今週はエヌビディアの決算発表、ジェンスン・フアン氏の今後の動向の明確化、アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）に対する市場の反応、米中ロ首脳の会合など、相場を左右するイベントが相次ぐため、市場は慎重な動きとなっている」と述べた。

豪株式市場には、ＡＩブームの中で世界の株価指数を押し上げてきた大手ハイテク企業が比較的少なく、これが最近の同セクターの混乱による影響を和らげている。

ただ、売りが長期化すれば、コモディティー価格の下落や幅広いリスク回避を通じて豪市場にも影響が波及する可能性があるとアナリストは指摘。ウォータラー氏は「影響を免れるにも限界がある」と述べた上で、売りが長引けば、投資家は全面的に撤退するのではなく、投資対象を一段と選別するようになるとの見方を示した。

非鉄金属価格への下押し圧力が続く中、鉱業大手のＢＨＰ、リオティント、フォーテスキューは２．２─２．９％下落した。

ロンドンの銅価格はＡＩ関連投資への懸念から４カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。鉄鉱石価格も、中国の鉱工業生産統計が低調だったことで鉄鋼需要への懸念が強まり、下落した。

キング資源相は、豪州最大のコモディティー（商品）輸出品である鉄鉱石の価格下落に懸念を示す一方、政府として契約交渉に介入する考えはないと述べた。

原油価格が一段安となる中、エネルギー株指数は０．５％下落した。

金融株指数はほぼ横ばいで終了。不動産株指数は０．８％、生活必需品株指数は０．７％それぞれ上昇した。

items.title: ASEAN-China Summit: Chinese Premier Li Qiang pledges support for early conclusion of South China Sea code of conduct
items.summary: According to PNA, Lazaro explained that while Beijing and ASEAN member states are pleased with how the discussions have advanced, a “lack of material time” prevented them from finalising the pact ...
items.body:
ASEAN-China Summit: Chinese Premier Li Qiang pledges support for early conclusion of South China Sea code of conduct According to PNA, Lazaro explained that while Beijing and ASEAN member states are pleased with how the discussions have advanced, a “lack of material time” prevented them from finalising the pact before the end of the year.
ANI | Updated: 16-11-2026 18:54 IST | Created: 16-11-2026 18:54 IST

Chinese Premier Li Qiang and Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr among other leaders at the 29th ASEAN-China Summit (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Chinese Premier Li Qiang has pledged to back the swift finalisation of a “substantive and effective” Code of Conduct (COC) for the South China Sea as Beijing and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) intensify efforts to wrap up talks on the agreement. Philippine Foreign Affairs Secretary Theresa Lazaro announced on Monday. According to the Philippine News Agency (PNA), Li voiced this pledge following his chairmanship of the ASEAN-China Summit held in Pasay City, PNA reported.
“An important statement of the Chinese Premier is when he said that he is committed towards an effective, substantive, and early conclusion of the Code of Conduct, which is consistent with the 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS),” Lazaro said, as per the state news agency. According to PNA, Lazaro explained that while Beijing and ASEAN member states are pleased with how the discussions have advanced, a “lack of material time” prevented them from finalising the pact before the end of the year.
“If we were given another five to six months, we could have finished it. But to say that it will be finished in 2027, (we) give it to Singapore,” she stated, as quoted by the Philippine News Agency. The agency further noted Lazaro's remarks that the Marcos administration has remained “very focused on the COC” and views reaching the 80 percent completion mark as encouraging momentum.
“We have done 80 percent or more than that. So, I don't think it's a failure. I think we have done what we have to do as far as Philippines as chair (is concerned). But we didn't have more time,” she said, according to PNA. As detailed in the Philippine News Agency report, the COC is designed strictly to act as a “mechanism for the constructive management of differences at sea,” with participating negotiators concurring that its purpose is not to resolve territorial disputes.
PNA also reported that negotiators have already resolved the link between the COC and the 2002 Declaration of Conduct (DOC)—previously one of four remaining sticking points—and have reached a consensus to utilise the completed agreement as a structure for joint maritime cooperation among the parties. Earlier, Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. stated that the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and China maintain a shared resolve to find common ground and advance practical collaboration despite existing regional and global uncertainties.
Marcos delivered the remarks during his opening address at the 29th ASEAN-China Summit, which was attended by Chinese Premier Li Qiang. The Philippines currently serves as the rotating chair of the regional bloc. Highlighting the diplomatic milestone, Marcos noted that the current year marks both the 35th anniversary of ASEAN-China dialogue relations and the fifth anniversary of their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership."Even amid regional and global uncertainties, ASEAN and China continue to find common ground and pursue tangible cooperation," he stated, further emphasising that both sides acknowledge the significance of advancing innovative approaches to tackle shared environmental challenges.
He stressed that the sides' shared commitment to international law and the peaceful settlement of disputes must be reflected in their actions, including through self-restraint, mutual respect and practical cooperation. Additionally, Marcos pointed out that ASEAN and China continue to actively participate in major trade and investment promotion initiatives to further broaden their economic cooperation.
He urged stakeholders to build upon the accomplishments of the partnership to foster peace, stability and prosperity across the region. (ANI)

items.summary: Four members of the same family remain missing following alleged detentions by Pakistani forces in Winder and Khuzdar, while six other men who had reportedly been subjected to enforced disappearances ...
items.body:
Four members of Baloch family remain missing after reported detentions in Winder and Khuzdar, six others return home Four members of the same family remain missing following alleged detentions by Pakistani forces in Winder and Khuzdar, while six other men who had reportedly been subjected to enforced disappearances in separate incidents across Balochistan have returned home, according to a report by The Balochistan Post (TBP).
ANI | Updated: 16-11-2026 18:26 IST | Created: 16-11-2026 18:26 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Four members of the same family remain missing following alleged detentions by Pakistani forces in Winder and Khuzdar, while six other men who had reportedly been subjected to enforced disappearances in separate incidents across Balochistan have returned home, according to a report by The Balochistan Post (TBP). Citing local sources, TBP reported that Frontier Corps (FC) and Counter Terrorism Department (CTD) personnel raided two houses in Winder on October 12. The four family members reportedly remain missing following the alleged detentions.
Meanwhile, local sources in Tump, in Kech district, reported overnight raids on several houses by Pakistani forces and members of an armed group they described as a state-backed "death squad". According to the report, those involved allegedly took cash, gold jewellery, vehicles and other valuables from the houses during the raids. The allegations have raised further concerns over the safety of civilians and incidents of intimidation and looting in the region.
In a separate development, six men who had reportedly been forcibly disappeared by Pakistani forces have returned home, TBP reported. Among those released are three residents of Gujjar in the Mashkay area of Awaran district, who had reportedly been missing since February 2. Their return marks a development for their families, who had been awaiting information about their whereabouts.
Meanwhile, the protest camp organised by the Voice for Baloch Missing Persons (VBMP) outside the Quetta Press Club continued for its 6,420th day on Sunday. Visitors to the camp expressed solidarity with families of missing persons and called for an end to enforced disappearances in Balochistan. VBMP Chairman Nasrullah Baloch described enforced disappearances as unconstitutional, unlawful and a serious violation of human rights, demanding the recovery of all missing persons.
"If any person is accused of an offence, they should be presented before a magistrate within 24 hours and the legal requirements should be fulfilled," he said. He further held the government responsible for ending enforced disappearances, safeguarding citizens' constitutional and legal rights, and ensuring justice for affected families. (ANI)

SYDNEY: Helen Haines, the Australian lawmaker who lost her legs after being repeatedly struck by a car in an attack, said on Monday (Nov 16) she had been discharged from hospital and was now focused on rehabilitation.
"This is a really positive moment," Haines said in her first public statement since the Oct 19 attack, adding that she appreciated the thousands of warm wishes and supportive messages she had received from people throughout Australia and around the world.
"They are giving me strength as I focus on this next phase of healing."
Haines, 65, was airlifted to hospital after being rammed by a car outside her office in the small town of Wangaratta in the state of Victoria last month. Surgeons amputated both of her legs.

Brendan Nugent, a resident of the town of Tarrawingee within Haines' electorate, has been charged with three offences over the incident : dangerous driving causing serious injury, intentionally causing serious injury, and causing harm to a public official.
During a court appearance in October, the accused's lawyer said his client had some mental health concerns and was also being treated for concussion, the Australian Broadcasting Corporation reported.
Haines, an independent lawmaker, was elected to parliament in 2019 for the rural seat of Indi, which she retained in 2022 and 2025.
Violent attacks on politicians are rare in Australia, where federal lawmakers, state leaders and even prime ministers are often seen shopping, grabbing coffee or attending community events with relatively little security.
However, concerns about politicians' safety have grown in recent years amid rising polarisation, online abuse and threats against elected officials, prompting calls for greater protections while preserving the accessibility that has long characterised Australian politics.

items.title: Jensen Huang discusses comeback as Nvidia CEO as allies rally support
items.summary: The report comes days after the FT reported that Nvidia's board had approached British chipmaker Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang ...
items.body:
Home / World News / Jensen Huang discusses comeback as Nvidia CEO as allies rally support

Jensen Huang discusses comeback as Nvidia CEO as allies rally support The report comes days after the FT reported that Nvidia's board had approached British chipmaker Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang

Huang stepped down on Thursday after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy that raised questions over exports of the company's advanced AI chips to China | Image: Bloomberg

Reuters 1 min read Last Updated : Nov 16 2026 | 8:04 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Jensen Huang is considering a comeback as Nvidia's chief executive, and has discussed with confidants the possibility of returning, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter.
  One Huang ally told the FT they were putting together a "war room" of Silicon Valley executives to lobby for the former Nvidia chief's return and would try to garner support from the White House.
  "Everyone that matters in tech outside the frontier labs loves Jensen," the person said, adding that the efforts had Huang's support.
  The report comes days after the FT reported that Nvidia's board had approached British chipmaker Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang.
 

  Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside regular business hours.
  Huang stepped down on Thursday after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a suspected Chinese spy that raised questions over exports of the company's advanced AI chips to China. The scandal has plunged the chipmaker into crisis and sent shockwaves across an AI industry he helped bankroll. 

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.title: Guinea gold mining crackdown leaves 10 dead, sparks exodus
items.author: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.summary: Mass expulsions overwhelm neighbouring countries as Mali warns of a humanitarian crisis and rising regional security threats.
items.body:
Guinea gold mining crackdown leaves 10 dead, sparks exodus

Staff Writer | November 13, 2026 | 3:53 am
Regulatory Issues   Africa   Aluminum   Bauxite   Gold  

Large piles of bauxite ore sit at a treatment area storage in Guinea. ( Stock image by Igor Groshev. )

Ten people have been killed in clashes between security forces and protesters in Guinea’s northeastern gold-producing region of Siguiri, as a government crackdown on illegal mining triggers mass expulsions and a growing humanitarian crisis in neighbouring countries.

The violence erupted Wednesday when defence and security forces attempted to enforce a Nov. 2 ban on unregulated artisanal gold mining , Reuters reported. Protesters erected barricades on public roads before the confrontation escalated into an exchange of gunfire, Guinea’s Ministry of Territorial Administration said in a statement.

Five foreign nationals were among those killed, while 13 people were injured, according to provisional government figures. Authorities did not disclose the nationalities of the foreign victims.

The unrest highlights the growing economic and humanitarian fallout from Guinea’s efforts to curb illegal gold production in a region where artisanal mining provides livelihoods for thousands of workers and their families. The crackdown has strained relations with neighbouring Mali and Burkina Faso, which are struggling to accommodate large numbers of expelled migrants.

Mass displacement

Guinea imposed the ban after authorities blamed unregulated mining operations for extensive environmental damage, including the contamination of agricultural land and rivers and the destruction of vegetation.

Security forces have arrested more than 1,200 suspected illegal miners in northeastern Guinea, with the first mass trials opening this week in the capital, Conakry.

The enforcement campaign has driven tens of thousands of miners and their families across the border into Mali, where authorities have warned of a potential humanitarian catastrophe.

About 100,000 displaced people have arrived in Mali’s capital, Bamako, while nearly 60,000 others have gathered in the border town of Kouremale, according to Malian authorities.

Guinea’s president announces ban on raw gold exports

The Malian government has also recorded 11 deaths linked to the displacement crisis, separate from the fatalities reported in Guinea.

Burkina Faso, meanwhile, said Friday it had repatriated 45,406 citizens forced to leave Guinea following the ban. Officials in Ouagadougou have complained that their nationals were subjected to inhumane treatment during the expulsions.

Regional security fears

The influx of displaced miners has raised concerns that armed extremist groups operating across the Sahel could exploit the growing humanitarian emergency to recruit vulnerable migrants.

“These people are vulnerable. We are looking at ways to prevent them from being approached by terrorist networks,” a Malian security ministry official told Agence France-Presse .

Guinea, the world’s largest bauxite producer, also holds significant gold reserves exploited by industrial operators including Société Aurifère de Guinée, a subsidiary of AngloGold Ashanti, alongside two semi-industrial companies and hundreds of artisanal miners.

Artisanal mining remains a major source of employment across West Africa, where rising metal prices and growing demand for gold have encouraged informal operations, often beyond the reach of government oversight.

items.title: テンセントがオラクルからAI半導体10万個をリース、70億ドル規模－FT
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、東南アジアでオラクルから先端のAI半導体を借り受けることで合意した。テンセントにとってAI半導体のリース契約としては過去最大規模となる。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）が事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、テンセントは、5年間の契約の一環として10万個の半導体を利用できるようになる。契約額は70億ドル（約1兆1000億円）に上るという。

中国のAI開発企業は米国の輸出規制を回避するため、米エヌビディア製など中国国内では入手できないAIアクセラレーターを海外で借りて利用している。中国のテクノロジー企業は、東南アジアのデータセンターの最大顧客層の一つとなっている。

テンセントとオラクルの担当者は、ブルームバーグ・ニュースのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

原題：Tencent Leases AI Chips From Oracle
